Matthew 2:2.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 2:2.text: asking, “Where is the One who has been born King of the Jews? We saw His star in the east and have come to worship Him.”

Matthew 3:14.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 3:14.text: But John tried to prevent Him, saying, “I need to be baptized by You, and do You come to me?”

Matthew 3:15.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 3:15.text: “Let it be so now,” Jesus replied. “It is fitting for us to fulfill all righteousness in this way.” Then John permitted Him.

Matthew 4:4.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 4:4.text: But Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.’”

Matthew 4:6.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 4:6.text: “If You are the Son of God,” he said, “throw Yourself down. For it is written: ‘He will command His angels concerning You, and they will lift You up in their hands, so that You will not strike Your foot against a stone.’”

Matthew 4:7.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 4:7.text: Jesus replied, “It is also written: ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’”

Matthew 4:9.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 4:9.text: “All this I will give You,” he said, “if You will fall down and worship me.”

Matthew 4:10.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 4:10.text: “Away from Me, Satan!” Jesus told him. “For it is written: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve Him only.’”

Matthew 4:15.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 4:15.text: “Land of Zebulun and land of Naphtali, the Way of the Sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles—

Matthew 4:16.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 4:16.text: the people living in darkness have seen a great light; on those living in the land of the shadow of death, a light has dawned.”

Matthew 4:17.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 4:17.text: From that time on Jesus began to preach, “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near.”

Matthew 4:19.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 4:19.text: “Come, follow Me,” Jesus said, “and I will make you fishers of men.”

Matthew 5:3.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:3.text: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

Matthew 5:4.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:4.text: Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted.

Matthew 5:5.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:5.text: Blessed are the meek, for they will inherit the earth.

Matthew 5:6.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:6.text: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they will be filled.

Matthew 5:7.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:7.text: Blessed are the merciful, for they will be shown mercy.

Matthew 5:8.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:8.text: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.

Matthew 5:9.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:9.text: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called sons of God.

Matthew 5:10.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:10.text: Blessed are those who are persecuted because of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

Matthew 5:11.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:11.text: Blessed are you when people insult you, persecute you, and falsely say all kinds of evil against you because of Me.

Matthew 5:12.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:12.text: Rejoice and be glad, because great is your reward in heaven, for in the same way they persecuted the prophets before you.

Matthew 5:13.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:13.text: You are the salt of the earth. But if the salt loses its savor, how can it be made salty again? It is no longer good for anything, except to be thrown out and trampled by men.

Matthew 5:14.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:14.text: You are the light of the world. A city on a hill cannot be hidden.

Matthew 5:15.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:15.text: Neither do people light a lamp and put it under a basket. Instead, they set it on a stand, and it gives light to everyone in the house.

Matthew 5:16.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:16.text: In the same way, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven.

Matthew 5:17.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:17.text: Do not think that I have come to abolish the Law or the Prophets. I have not come to abolish them, but to fulfill them.

Matthew 5:18.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:18.text: For I tell you truly, until heaven and earth pass away, not a single jot, not a stroke of a pen, will disappear from the Law until everything is accomplished.

Matthew 5:19.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:19.text: So then, whoever breaks one of the least of these commandments and teaches others to do likewise will be called least in the kingdom of heaven; but whoever practices and teaches them will be called great in the kingdom of heaven.

Matthew 5:20.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:20.text: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.

Matthew 5:21.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:21.text: You have heard that it was said to the ancients, ‘Do not murder’ and ‘Anyone who murders will be subject to judgment.’

Matthew 5:22.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:22.text: But I tell you that anyone who is angry with his brother will be subject to judgment. Again, anyone who says to his brother, ‘Raca,’ will be subject to the Sanhedrin. But anyone who says, ‘You fool!’ will be subject to the fire of hell.

Matthew 5:23.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:23.text: So if you are offering your gift at the altar and there remember that your brother has something against you,

Matthew 5:24.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:24.text: leave your gift there before the altar. First go and be reconciled to your brother; then come and offer your gift.

Matthew 5:25.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:25.text: Reconcile quickly with your adversary, while you are still on the way to court. Otherwise, he may hand you over to the judge, and the judge may hand you over to the officer, and you may be thrown into prison.

Matthew 5:26.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:26.text: Truly I tell you, you will not get out until you have paid the last penny.

Matthew 5:27.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:27.text: You have heard that it was said, ‘Do not commit adultery.’

Matthew 5:28.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:28.text: But I tell you that anyone who looks at a woman to lust after her has already committed adultery with her in his heart.

Matthew 5:29.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:29.text: If your right eye causes you to sin, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to be thrown into hell.

Matthew 5:30.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:30.text: And if your right hand causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to depart into hell.

Matthew 5:31.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:31.text: It has also been said, ‘Whoever divorces his wife must give her a certificate of divorce.’

Matthew 5:32.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:32.text: But I tell you that anyone who divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, brings adultery upon her. And he who marries a divorced woman commits adultery.

Matthew 5:33.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:33.text: Again, you have heard that it was said to the ancients, ‘Do not break your oath, but fulfill your vows to the Lord.’

Matthew 5:34.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:34.text: But I tell you not to swear at all: either by heaven, for it is God’s throne;

Matthew 5:35.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:35.text: or by the earth, for it is His footstool; or by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.

Matthew 5:36.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:36.text: Nor should you swear by your head, for you cannot make a single hair white or black.

Matthew 5:37.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:37.text: Simply let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes,’ and your ‘No,’ ‘No.’ Anything more comes from the evil one.

Matthew 5:38.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:38.text: You have heard that it was said, ‘Eye for eye and tooth for tooth.’

Matthew 5:39.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:39.text: But I tell you not to resist an evil person. If someone slaps you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also;

Matthew 5:40.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:40.text: if someone wants to sue you and take your tunic, let him have your cloak as well;

Matthew 5:41.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:41.text: and if someone forces you to go one mile, go with him two miles.

Matthew 5:42.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:42.text: Give to the one who asks you, and do not turn away from the one who wants to borrow from you.

Matthew 5:43.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:43.text: You have heard that it was said, ‘Love your neighbor’ and ‘Hate your enemy.’

Matthew 5:44.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:44.text: But I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,

Matthew 5:45.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:45.text: that you may be sons of your Father in heaven. He causes His sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the righteous and the unrighteous.

Matthew 5:46.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:46.text: If you love those who love you, what reward will you get? Do not even tax collectors do the same?

Matthew 5:47.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:47.text: And if you greet only your brothers, what are you doing more than others? Do not even Gentiles do the same?

Matthew 5:48.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 5:48.text: Be perfect, therefore, as your heavenly Father is perfect.

Matthew 6:1.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:1.text: “Be careful not to perform your righteous acts before men to be seen by them. If you do, you will have no reward from your Father in heaven.

Matthew 6:2.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:2.text: So when you give to the needy, do not sound a trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and on the streets, to be honored by men. Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.

Matthew 6:3.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:3.text: But when you give to the needy, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing,

Matthew 6:4.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:4.text: so that your giving may be in secret. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.

Matthew 6:5.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:5.text: And when you pray, do not be like the hypocrites. For they love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the street corners to be seen by men. Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.

Matthew 6:6.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:6.text: But when you pray, go into your inner room, shut your door, and pray to your Father, who is unseen. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.

Matthew 6:7.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:7.text: And when you pray, do not babble on like pagans, for they think that by their many words they will be heard.

Matthew 6:8.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:8.text: Do not be like them, for your Father knows what you need before you ask Him.

Matthew 6:9.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:9.text: So then, this is how you should pray: ‘Our Father in heaven, hallowed be Your name.

Matthew 6:10.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:10.text: Your kingdom come, Your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.

Matthew 6:11.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:11.text: Give us this day our daily bread.

Matthew 6:12.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:12.text: And forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.

Matthew 6:13.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:13.text: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.’

Matthew 6:14.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:14.text: For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.

Matthew 6:15.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:15.text: But if you do not forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive yours.

Matthew 6:16.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:16.text: When you fast, do not be somber like the hypocrites, for they disfigure their faces to show men they are fasting. Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.

Matthew 6:17.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:17.text: But when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,

Matthew 6:18.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:18.text: so that your fasting will not be obvious to men, but only to your Father, who is unseen. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.

Matthew 6:19.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:19.text: Do not store up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moth and rust destroy, and where thieves break in and steal.

Matthew 6:20.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:20.text: But store up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where moth and rust do not destroy, and where thieves do not break in and steal.

Matthew 6:21.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:21.text: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

Matthew 6:22.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:22.text: The eye is the lamp of the body. If your eyes are good, your whole body will be full of light.

Matthew 6:23.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:23.text: But if your eyes are bad, your whole body will be full of darkness. If then the light within you is darkness, how great is that darkness!

Matthew 6:24.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:24.text: No one can serve two masters: Either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and money.

Matthew 6:25.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:25.text: Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat or drink; or about your body, what you will wear. Is not life more than food, and the body more than clothes?

Matthew 6:26.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:26.text: Look at the birds of the air: They do not sow or reap or gather into barns, and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not much more valuable than they?

Matthew 6:27.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:27.text: Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to his life?

Matthew 6:28.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:28.text: And why do you worry about clothes? Consider how the lilies of the field grow: They do not labor or spin.

Matthew 6:29.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:29.text: Yet I tell you that not even Solomon in all his glory was adorned like one of these.

Matthew 6:30.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:30.text: If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace, will He not much more clothe you, O you of little faith?

Matthew 6:31.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:31.text: Therefore do not worry, saying, ‘What shall we eat?’ or ‘What shall we drink?’ or ‘What shall we wear?’

Matthew 6:32.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:32.text: For the Gentiles strive after all these things, and your heavenly Father knows that you need them.

Matthew 6:33.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:33.text: But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added unto you.

Matthew 6:34.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 6:34.text: Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Today has enough trouble of its own.

Matthew 7:1.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 7:1.text: “Do not judge, or you will be judged.

Matthew 7:2.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 7:2.text: For with the same judgment you pronounce, you will be judged, and with the measure you use, it will be measured to you.

Matthew 7:3.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 7:3.text: Why do you look at the speck in your brother’s eye but fail to notice the beam in your own eye?

Matthew 7:4.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 7:4.text: How can you say to your brother, ‘Let me take the speck out of your eye,’ while there is still a beam in your own eye?

Matthew 7:5.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 7:5.text: You hypocrite! First take the beam out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother’s eye.

Matthew 7:6.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 7:6.text: Do not give dogs what is holy; do not throw your pearls before swine. If you do, they may trample them under their feet, and then turn and tear you to pieces.

Matthew 7:7.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 7:7.text: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.

Matthew 7:8.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 7:8.text: For everyone who asks receives; he who seeks finds; and to him who knocks, the door will be opened.

Matthew 7:9.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 7:9.text: Which of you, if his son asks for bread, will give him a stone?

Matthew 7:10.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 7:10.text: Or if he asks for a fish, will give him a snake?

Matthew 7:11.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 7:11.text: So if you who are evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good things to those who ask Him!

Matthew 7:12.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 7:12.text: In everything, then, do to others as you would have them do to you. For this is the essence of the Law and the Prophets.

Matthew 7:13.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 7:13.text: Enter through the narrow gate. For wide is the gate and broad is the way that leads to destruction, and many enter through it.

Matthew 7:14.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 7:14.text: But small is the gate and narrow the way that leads to life, and only a few find it.

Matthew 7:15.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 7:15.text: Beware of false prophets. They come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravenous wolves.

Matthew 7:16.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 7:16.text: By their fruit you will recognize them. Are grapes gathered from thornbushes, or figs from thistles?

Matthew 7:17.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 7:17.text: Likewise, every good tree bears good fruit, but a bad tree bears bad fruit.

Matthew 7:18.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 7:18.text: A good tree cannot bear bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot bear good fruit.

Matthew 7:19.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 7:19.text: Every tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.

Matthew 7:20.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 7:20.text: So then, by their fruit you will recognize them.

Matthew 7:21.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 7:21.text: Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only he who does the will of My Father in heaven.

Matthew 7:22.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 7:22.text: Many will say to Me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in Your name, and in Your name drive out demons and perform many miracles?’

Matthew 7:23.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 7:23.text: Then I will tell them plainly, ‘I never knew you; depart from Me, you workers of lawlessness!’

Matthew 7:24.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 7:24.text: Therefore everyone who hears these words of Mine and acts on them is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.

Matthew 7:25.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 7:25.text: The rain fell, the torrents raged, and the winds blew and beat against that house; yet it did not fall, because its foundation was on the rock.

Matthew 7:26.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 7:26.text: But everyone who hears these words of Mine and does not act on them is like a foolish man who built his house on sand.

Matthew 7:27.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 7:27.text: The rain fell, the torrents raged, and the winds blew and beat against that house, and it fell—and great was its collapse!”

Matthew 8:2.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 8:2.text: Suddenly a leper came and knelt before Him, saying, “Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean.”

Matthew 8:3.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 8:3.text: Jesus reached out His hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” He said. “Be clean!” And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

Matthew 8:4.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 8:4.text: Then Jesus instructed him, “See that you don’t tell anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and offer the gift prescribed by Moses, as a testimony to them.”

Matthew 8:6.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 8:6.text: “Lord, my servant lies at home, paralyzed and in terrible agony.”

Matthew 8:7.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 8:7.text: “I will go and heal him,” Jesus replied.

Matthew 8:10.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 8:10.text: When Jesus heard this, He marveled and said to those following Him, “Truly I tell you, I have not found anyone in Israel with such great faith.

Matthew 8:11.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 8:11.text: I say to you that many will come from the east and the west to share the banquet with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven.

Matthew 8:12.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 8:12.text: But the sons of the kingdom will be thrown into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

Matthew 8:13.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 8:13.text: Then Jesus said to the centurion, “Go! As you have believed, so will it be done for you.” And his servant was healed at that very hour.

Matthew 8:17.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 8:17.text: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah: “He took up our infirmities and carried our diseases.”

Matthew 8:20.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 8:20.text: Jesus replied, “Foxes have dens and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head.”

Matthew 8:21.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 8:21.text: Another of His disciples requested, “Lord, first let me go and bury my father.”

Matthew 8:22.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 8:22.text: But Jesus told him, “Follow Me, and let the dead bury their own dead.”

Matthew 8:25.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 8:25.text: The disciples went and woke Him, saying, “Lord, save us! We are perishing!”

Matthew 8:26.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 8:26.text: “You of little faith,” Jesus replied, “why are you so afraid?” Then He got up and rebuked the winds and the sea, and it was perfectly calm.

Matthew 8:29.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 8:29.text: “What do You want with us, Son of God?” they shouted. “Have You come here to torture us before the appointed time?”

Matthew 8:31.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 8:31.text: So the demons begged Jesus, “If You drive us out, send us into the herd of pigs.”

Matthew 8:32.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 8:32.text: “Go!” He told them. So they came out and went into the pigs, and the whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the sea and died in the waters.

Matthew 9:2.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 9:2.text: Just then some men brought to Him a paralytic lying on a mat. When Jesus saw their faith, He said to the paralytic, “Take courage, son; your sins are forgiven.”

Matthew 9:4.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 9:4.text: But Jesus knew what they were thinking and said, “Why do you harbor evil in your hearts?

Matthew 9:5.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 9:5.text: Which is easier: to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk’?

Matthew 9:6.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 9:6.text: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins...” Then He said to the paralytic, “Get up, pick up your mat, and go home.”

Matthew 9:9.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 9:9.text: As Jesus went on from there, He saw a man named Matthew sitting at the tax booth. “Follow Me,” He told him, and Matthew got up and followed Him.

Matthew 9:12.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 9:12.text: On hearing this, Jesus said, “It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick.

Matthew 9:13.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 9:13.text: But go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice.’ For I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners.”

Matthew 9:14.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 9:14.text: Then John’s disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Why is it that we and the Pharisees fast so often, but Your disciples do not fast?”

Matthew 9:15.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 9:15.text: Jesus replied, “How can the guests of the bridegroom mourn while He is with them? But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; then they will fast.

Matthew 9:16.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 9:16.text: No one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment. For the patch will pull away from the garment, and a worse tear will result.

Matthew 9:17.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 9:17.text: Neither do men pour new wine into old wineskins. If they do, the skins will burst, the wine will spill, and the wineskins will be ruined. Instead, they pour new wine into new wineskins, and both are preserved.”

Matthew 9:18.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 9:18.text: While Jesus was saying these things, a synagogue leader came and knelt before Him. “My daughter has just died,” he said. “But come and place Your hand on her, and she will live.”

Matthew 9:22.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 9:22.text: Jesus turned and saw her. “Take courage, daughter,” He said, “your faith has healed you.” And the woman was healed from that very hour.

Matthew 9:24.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 9:24.text: “Go away,” He told them. “The girl is not dead, but asleep.” And they laughed at Him.

Matthew 9:27.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 9:27.text: As Jesus went on from there, two blind men followed Him, crying out, “Have mercy on us, Son of David!”

Matthew 9:28.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 9:28.text: After Jesus had entered the house, the blind men came to Him. “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” He asked. “Yes, Lord,” they answered.

Matthew 9:29.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 9:29.text: Then He touched their eyes and said, “According to your faith will it be done to you.”

Matthew 9:30.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 9:30.text: And their eyes were opened. Jesus warned them sternly, “See that no one finds out about this!”

Matthew 9:37.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 9:37.text: Then He said to His disciples, “The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few.

Matthew 9:38.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 9:38.text: Ask the Lord of the harvest, therefore, to send out workers into His harvest.”

Matthew 10:5.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:5.text: These twelve Jesus sent out with the following instructions: “Do not go onto the road of the Gentiles or enter any town of the Samaritans.

Matthew 10:6.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:6.text: Go rather to the lost sheep of Israel.

Matthew 10:7.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:7.text: As you go, preach this message: ‘The kingdom of heaven is near.’

Matthew 10:8.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:8.text: Heal the sick, raise the dead, cleanse the lepers, drive out demons. Freely you have received; freely give.

Matthew 10:9.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:9.text: Do not take along any gold or silver or copper in your belts.

Matthew 10:10.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:10.text: Take no bag for the road, or second tunic, or sandals, or staff; for the worker is worthy of his provisions.

Matthew 10:11.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:11.text: Whatever town or village you enter, find out who is worthy there and stay at his house until you move on.

Matthew 10:12.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:12.text: As you enter the home, greet its occupants.

Matthew 10:13.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:13.text: If the home is worthy, let your peace rest on it, but if it is not, let your peace return to you.

Matthew 10:14.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:14.text: And if anyone will not welcome you or heed your words, shake the dust off your feet when you leave that home or town.

Matthew 10:15.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:15.text: Truly I tell you, it will be more bearable for Sodom and Gomorrah on the day of judgment than for that town.

Matthew 10:16.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:16.text: Behold, I am sending you out like sheep among wolves; therefore be as shrewd as snakes and as innocent as doves.

Matthew 10:17.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:17.text: But beware of men, for they will hand you over to their councils and flog you in their synagogues.

Matthew 10:18.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:18.text: On My account you will be brought before governors and kings as witnesses to them and to the Gentiles.

Matthew 10:19.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:19.text: But when they hand you over, do not worry about how to respond or what to say. In that hour you will be given what to say.

Matthew 10:20.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:20.text: For it will not be you speaking, but the Spirit of your Father speaking through you.

Matthew 10:21.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:21.text: Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child; children will rise against their parents and have them put to death.

Matthew 10:22.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:22.text: You will be hated by everyone because of My name, but the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.

Matthew 10:23.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:23.text: When they persecute you in one town, flee to the next. Truly I tell you, you will not reach all the towns of Israel before the Son of Man comes.

Matthew 10:24.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:24.text: A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his master.

Matthew 10:25.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:25.text: It is enough for a disciple to be like his teacher, and a servant like his master. If the head of the house has been called Beelzebul, how much more the members of his household!

Matthew 10:26.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:26.text: So do not be afraid of them. For there is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed, and nothing hidden that will not be made known.

Matthew 10:27.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:27.text: What I tell you in the dark, speak in the daylight; what is whispered in your ear, proclaim from the housetops.

Matthew 10:28.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:28.text: Do not be afraid of those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul. Instead, fear the One who can destroy both soul and body in hell.

Matthew 10:29.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:29.text: Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? Yet not one of them will fall to the ground apart from the will of your Father.

Matthew 10:30.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:30.text: And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

Matthew 10:31.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:31.text: So do not be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.

Matthew 10:32.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:32.text: Therefore everyone who confesses Me before men, I will also confess him before My Father in heaven.

Matthew 10:33.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:33.text: But whoever denies Me before men, I will also deny him before My Father in heaven.

Matthew 10:34.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:34.text: Do not assume that I have come to bring peace to the earth; I have not come to bring peace, but a sword.

Matthew 10:35.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:35.text: For I have come to turn ‘a man against his father, a daughter against her mother, a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.

Matthew 10:36.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:36.text: A man’s enemies will be the members of his own household.’

Matthew 10:37.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:37.text: Anyone who loves his father or mother more than Me is not worthy of Me; anyone who loves his son or daughter more than Me is not worthy of Me;

Matthew 10:38.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:38.text: and anyone who does not take up his cross and follow Me is not worthy of Me.

Matthew 10:39.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:39.text: Whoever finds his life will lose it, and whoever loses his life for My sake will find it.

Matthew 10:40.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:40.text: He who receives you receives Me, and he who receives Me receives the One who sent Me.

Matthew 10:41.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:41.text: Whoever receives a prophet because he is a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward, and whoever receives a righteous man because he is a righteous man will receive a righteous man’s reward.

Matthew 10:42.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 10:42.text: And if anyone gives even a cup of cold water to one of these little ones because he is My disciple, truly I tell you, he will never lose his reward.”

Matthew 11:3.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 11:3.text: to ask Him, “Are You the One who was to come, or should we look for someone else?”

Matthew 11:4.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 11:4.text: Jesus replied, “Go back and report to John what you hear and see:

Matthew 11:5.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 11:5.text: The blind receive sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the good news is preached to the poor.

Matthew 11:6.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 11:6.text: Blessed is the one who does not fall away on account of Me.”

Matthew 11:7.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 11:7.text: As John’s disciples were leaving, Jesus began to speak to the crowds about John: “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed swaying in the wind?

Matthew 11:8.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 11:8.text: Otherwise, what did you go out to see? A man dressed in fine clothes? Look, those who wear fine clothing are found in kings’ palaces.

Matthew 11:9.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 11:9.text: What then did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.

Matthew 11:10.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 11:10.text: This is the one about whom it is written: ‘Behold, I will send My messenger ahead of You, who will prepare Your way before You.’

Matthew 11:11.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 11:11.text: Truly I tell you, among those born of women there has risen no one greater than John the Baptist. Yet even the least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.

Matthew 11:12.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 11:12.text: From the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven has been subject to violence, and the violent lay claim to it.

Matthew 11:13.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 11:13.text: For all the Prophets and the Law prophesied until John.

Matthew 11:14.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 11:14.text: And if you are willing to accept it, he is the Elijah who was to come.

Matthew 11:15.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 11:15.text: He who has ears, let him hear.

Matthew 11:16.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 11:16.text: To what can I compare this generation? They are like children sitting in the marketplaces and calling out to others:

Matthew 11:17.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 11:17.text: ‘We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not mourn.’

Matthew 11:18.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 11:18.text: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon!’

Matthew 11:19.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 11:19.text: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Look at this glutton and drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ But wisdom is vindicated by her actions.”

Matthew 11:21.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 11:21.text: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.

Matthew 11:22.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 11:22.text: But I tell you, it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.

Matthew 11:23.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 11:23.text: And you, Capernaum, will you be lifted up to heaven? No, you will be brought down to Hades! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Sodom, it would have remained to this day.

Matthew 11:24.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 11:24.text: But I tell you that it will be more bearable for Sodom on the day of judgment than for you.”

Matthew 11:25.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 11:25.text: At that time Jesus declared, “I praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because You have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children.

Matthew 11:26.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 11:26.text: Yes, Father, for this was well-pleasing in Your sight.

Matthew 11:27.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 11:27.text: All things have been entrusted to Me by My Father. No one knows the Son except the Father, and no one knows the Father except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal Him.

Matthew 11:28.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 11:28.text: Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

Matthew 11:29.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 11:29.text: Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.

Matthew 11:30.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 11:30.text: For My yoke is easy and My burden is light.”

Matthew 12:3.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:3.text: Jesus replied, “Have you not read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?

Matthew 12:4.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:4.text: He entered the house of God, and he and his companions ate the consecrated bread, which was not lawful for them to eat, but only for the priests.

Matthew 12:5.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:5.text: Or haven’t you read in the Law that on the Sabbath the priests in the temple break the Sabbath and yet are innocent?

Matthew 12:6.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:6.text: But I tell you that One greater than the temple is here.

Matthew 12:7.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:7.text: If only you had known the meaning of ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice,’ you would not have condemned the innocent.

Matthew 12:8.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:8.text: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”

Matthew 12:10.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:10.text: and a man with a withered hand was there. In order to accuse Jesus, they asked Him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”

Matthew 12:11.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:11.text: He replied, “If one of you has a sheep and it falls into a pit on the Sabbath, will he not take hold of it and lift it out?

Matthew 12:12.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:12.text: How much more valuable is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath.”

Matthew 12:13.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:13.text: Then Jesus said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” So he stretched it out, and it was restored to full use, just like the other.

Matthew 12:18.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:18.text: “Here is My Servant, whom I have chosen, My beloved, in whom My soul delights. I will put My Spirit on Him, and He will proclaim justice to the nations.

Matthew 12:19.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:19.text: He will not quarrel or cry out; no one will hear His voice in the streets.

Matthew 12:20.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:20.text: A bruised reed He will not break, and a smoldering wick He will not extinguish, till He leads justice to victory.

Matthew 12:21.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:21.text: In His name the nations will put their hope.”

Matthew 12:25.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:25.text: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself will be laid waste, and every city or household divided against itself will not stand.

Matthew 12:26.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:26.text: If Satan drives out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then can his kingdom stand?

Matthew 12:27.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:27.text: And if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your sons drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.

Matthew 12:28.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:28.text: But if I drive out demons by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.

Matthew 12:29.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:29.text: Or again, how can anyone enter a strong man’s house and steal his possessions, unless he first ties up the strong man? Then he can plunder his house.

Matthew 12:30.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:30.text: He who is not with Me is against Me, and he who does not gather with Me scatters.

Matthew 12:31.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:31.text: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven.

Matthew 12:32.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:32.text: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven, either in this age or in the one to come.

Matthew 12:33.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:33.text: Make a tree good and its fruit will be good, or make a tree bad and its fruit will be bad, for a tree is known by its fruit.

Matthew 12:34.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:34.text: You brood of vipers, how can you who are evil say anything good? For out of the overflow of the heart the mouth speaks.

Matthew 12:35.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:35.text: The good man brings good things out of his good store of treasure, and the evil man brings evil things out of his evil store of treasure.

Matthew 12:36.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:36.text: But I tell you that men will give an account on the day of judgment for every careless word they have spoken.

Matthew 12:37.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:37.text: For by your words you will be acquitted, and by your words you will be condemned.”

Matthew 12:39.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:39.text: Jesus replied, “A wicked and adulterous generation demands a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of the prophet Jonah.

Matthew 12:40.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:40.text: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the great fish, so the Son of Man will be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

Matthew 12:41.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:41.text: The men of Nineveh will stand at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and now One greater than Jonah is here.

Matthew 12:42.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:42.text: The Queen of the South will rise at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and now One greater than Solomon is here.

Matthew 12:43.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:43.text: When an unclean spirit comes out of a man, it passes through arid places seeking rest and does not find it.

Matthew 12:44.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:44.text: Then it says, ‘I will return to the house I left.’ On its return, it finds the house vacant, swept clean, and put in order.

Matthew 12:45.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:45.text: Then it goes and brings with it seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in and dwell there. And the final plight of that man is worse than the first. So will it be with this wicked generation.”

Matthew 12:48.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:48.text: But Jesus replied, “Who is My mother, and who are My brothers?”

Matthew 12:49.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:49.text: Pointing to His disciples, He said, “Here are My mother and My brothers.

Matthew 12:50.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 12:50.text: For whoever does the will of My Father in heaven is My brother and sister and mother.”

Matthew 13:3.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:3.text: And He told them many things in parables, saying, “A farmer went out to sow his seed.

Matthew 13:4.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:4.text: And as he was sowing, some seed fell along the path, and the birds came and devoured it.

Matthew 13:5.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:5.text: Some fell on rocky ground, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly because the soil was shallow.

Matthew 13:6.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:6.text: But when the sun rose, the seedlings were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.

Matthew 13:7.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:7.text: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the seedlings.

Matthew 13:8.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:8.text: Still other seed fell on good soil and produced a crop—a hundredfold, sixtyfold, or thirtyfold.

Matthew 13:9.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:9.text: He who has ears, let him hear.”

Matthew 13:10.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:10.text: Then the disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Why do You speak to the people in parables?”

Matthew 13:11.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:11.text: He replied, “The knowledge of the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven has been given to you, but not to them.

Matthew 13:12.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:12.text: Whoever has will be given more, and he will have an abundance. Whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.

Matthew 13:13.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:13.text: This is why I speak to them in parables: ‘Though seeing, they do not see; though hearing, they do not hear or understand.’

Matthew 13:14.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:14.text: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled: ‘You will be ever hearing but never understanding; you will be ever seeing but never perceiving.

Matthew 13:15.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:15.text: For this people’s heart has grown callous; they hardly hear with their ears, and they have closed their eyes. Otherwise they might see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their hearts, and turn, and I would heal them.’

Matthew 13:16.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:16.text: But blessed are your eyes because they see, and your ears because they hear.

Matthew 13:17.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:17.text: For truly I tell you, many prophets and righteous men longed to see what you see but did not see it, and to hear what you hear but did not hear it.

Matthew 13:18.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:18.text: Consider, then, the parable of the sower:

Matthew 13:19.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:19.text: When anyone hears the message of the kingdom but does not understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away what was sown in his heart. This is the seed sown along the path.

Matthew 13:20.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:20.text: The seed sown on rocky ground is the one who hears the word and at once receives it with joy.

Matthew 13:21.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:21.text: But since he has no root, he remains for only a season. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, he quickly falls away.

Matthew 13:22.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:22.text: The seed sown among the thorns is the one who hears the word, but the worries of this life and the deceitfulness of wealth choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.

Matthew 13:23.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:23.text: But the seed sown on good soil is the one who hears the word and understands it. He indeed bears fruit and produces a crop—a hundredfold, sixtyfold, or thirtyfold.”

Matthew 13:24.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:24.text: Jesus put before them another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field.

Matthew 13:25.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:25.text: But while everyone was asleep, his enemy came and sowed weeds among the wheat, and slipped away.

Matthew 13:26.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:26.text: When the wheat sprouted and bore grain, then the weeds also appeared.

Matthew 13:27.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:27.text: The owner’s servants came to him and said, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where then did the weeds come from?’

Matthew 13:28.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:28.text: ‘An enemy did this,’ he replied. So the servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and pull them up?’

Matthew 13:29.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:29.text: ‘No,’ he said, ‘if you pull the weeds now, you might uproot the wheat with them.

Matthew 13:30.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:30.text: Let both grow together until the harvest. At that time I will tell the harvesters: First collect the weeds and tie them in bundles to be burned; then gather the wheat into my barn.’”

Matthew 13:35.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:35.text: So was fulfilled what was spoken through the prophet: “I will open My mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden since the foundation of the world.”

Matthew 13:37.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:37.text: He replied, “The One who sows the good seed is the Son of Man.

Matthew 13:38.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:38.text: The field is the world, and the good seed represents the sons of the kingdom. The weeds are the sons of the evil one,

Matthew 13:39.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:39.text: and the enemy who sows them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the harvesters are angels.

Matthew 13:40.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:40.text: As the weeds are collected and burned in the fire, so will it be at the end of the age.

Matthew 13:41.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:41.text: The Son of Man will send out His angels, and they will weed out of His kingdom every cause of sin and all who practice lawlessness.

Matthew 13:42.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:42.text: And they will throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

Matthew 13:43.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:43.text: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the kingdom of their Father. He who has ears, let him hear.

Matthew 13:44.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:44.text: The kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field. When a man found it, he hid it again, and in his joy he went and sold all he had and bought that field.

Matthew 13:45.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:45.text: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant in search of fine pearls.

Matthew 13:46.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:46.text: When he found one very precious pearl, he went away and sold all he had and bought it.

Matthew 13:47.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:47.text: Once again, the kingdom of heaven is like a net that was cast into the sea and caught all kinds of fish.

Matthew 13:48.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:48.text: When it was full, the men pulled it ashore. Then they sat down and sorted the good fish into containers, but threw the bad away.

Matthew 13:49.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:49.text: So will it be at the end of the age: The angels will come and separate the wicked from the righteous

Matthew 13:50.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:50.text: and throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

Matthew 13:51.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:51.text: Have you understood all these things?” “Yes,” they answered.

Matthew 13:54.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:54.text: Coming to His hometown, He taught the people in their synagogue, and they were astonished. “Where did this man get such wisdom and miraculous powers?” they asked.

Matthew 13:55.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:55.text: “Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t His mother’s name Mary, and aren’t His brothers James, Joseph, Simon, and Judas?

Matthew 13:56.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:56.text: Aren’t all His sisters with us as well? Where then did this man get all these things?”

Matthew 13:57.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 13:57.text: And they took offense at Him. But Jesus said to them, “Only in his hometown and in his own household is a prophet without honor.”

Matthew 14:16.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 14:16.text: “They do not need to go away,” Jesus replied. “You give them something to eat.”

Matthew 14:18.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 14:18.text: “Bring them here to Me,” Jesus said.

Matthew 14:27.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 14:27.text: But Jesus spoke up at once: “Take courage! It is I. Do not be afraid.”

Matthew 14:29.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 14:29.text: “Come,” said Jesus. Then Peter got down out of the boat, walked on the water, and came toward Jesus.

Matthew 14:31.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 14:31.text: Immediately Jesus reached out His hand and took hold of Peter. “You of little faith,” He said, “why did you doubt?”

Matthew 14:33.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 14:33.text: Then those who were in the boat worshiped Him, saying, “Truly You are the Son of God!”

Matthew 15:2.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 15:2.text: “Why do Your disciples break the tradition of the elders? They do not wash their hands before they eat.”

Matthew 15:3.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 15:3.text: Jesus replied, “And why do you break the command of God for the sake of your tradition?

Matthew 15:4.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 15:4.text: For God said, ‘Honor your father and mother’ and ‘Anyone who curses his father or mother must be put to death.’

Matthew 15:5.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 15:5.text: But you say that if anyone says to his father or mother, ‘Whatever you would have received from me is a gift devoted to God,’

Matthew 15:6.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 15:6.text: he need not honor his father or mother with it. Thus you nullify the word of God for the sake of your tradition.

Matthew 15:7.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 15:7.text: You hypocrites! Isaiah prophesied correctly about you:

Matthew 15:8.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 15:8.text: ‘These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me.

Matthew 15:9.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 15:9.text: They worship Me in vain; they teach as doctrine the precepts of men.’”

Matthew 15:10.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 15:10.text: Jesus called the crowd to Him and said, “Listen and understand.

Matthew 15:11.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 15:11.text: A man is not defiled by what enters his mouth, but by what comes out of it.”

Matthew 15:13.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 15:13.text: But Jesus replied, “Every plant that My heavenly Father has not planted will be pulled up by its roots.

Matthew 15:14.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 15:14.text: Disregard them! They are blind guides. If a blind man leads a blind man, both will fall into a pit.”

Matthew 15:16.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 15:16.text: “Do you still not understand?” Jesus asked.

Matthew 15:17.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 15:17.text: “Do you not yet realize that whatever enters the mouth goes into the stomach and then is eliminated?

Matthew 15:18.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 15:18.text: But the things that come out of the mouth come from the heart, and these things defile a man.

Matthew 15:19.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 15:19.text: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murder, adultery, sexual immorality, theft, false testimony, and slander.

Matthew 15:20.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 15:20.text: These are what defile a man, but eating with unwashed hands does not defile him.”

Matthew 15:22.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 15:22.text: And a Canaanite woman from that region came to Him, crying out, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on me! My daughter is miserably possessed by a demon.”

Matthew 15:23.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 15:23.text: But Jesus did not answer a word. So His disciples came and urged Him, “Send her away, for she keeps crying out after us.”

Matthew 15:24.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 15:24.text: He answered, “I was sent only to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”

Matthew 15:26.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 15:26.text: But Jesus replied, “It is not right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs.”

Matthew 15:28.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 15:28.text: “O woman,” Jesus answered, “your faith is great! Let it be done for you as you desire.” And her daughter was healed from that very hour.

Matthew 15:32.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 15:32.text: Then Jesus called His disciples to Him and said, “I have compassion for this crowd, because they have already been with Me three days and have nothing to eat. I do not want to send them away hungry, or they may faint along the way.”

Matthew 15:34.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 15:34.text: “How many loaves do you have?” Jesus asked. “Seven,” they replied, “and a few small fish.”

Matthew 16:2.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 16:2.text: But He replied, “When evening comes, you say, ‘The weather will be fair, for the sky is red,’

Matthew 16:3.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 16:3.text: and in the morning, ‘Today it will be stormy, for the sky is red and overcast.’ You know how to interpret the appearance of the sky, but not the signs of the times.

Matthew 16:4.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 16:4.text: A wicked and adulterous generation demands a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of Jonah.” Then He left them and went away.

Matthew 16:6.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 16:6.text: “Watch out!” Jesus told them. “Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

Matthew 16:7.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 16:7.text: They discussed this among themselves and concluded, “It is because we did not bring any bread.”

Matthew 16:8.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 16:8.text: Aware of their conversation, Jesus said, “You of little faith, why are you debating among yourselves about having no bread?

Matthew 16:9.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 16:9.text: Do you still not understand? Do you not remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?

Matthew 16:10.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 16:10.text: Or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?

Matthew 16:11.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 16:11.text: How do you not understand that I was not telling you about bread? But beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

Matthew 16:13.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 16:13.text: When Jesus came to the region of Caesarea Philippi, He questioned His disciples: “Who do people say the Son of Man is?”

Matthew 16:15.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 16:15.text: “But what about you?” Jesus asked. “Who do you say I am?”

Matthew 16:17.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 16:17.text: Jesus replied, “Blessed are you, Simon son of Jonah! For this was not revealed to you by flesh and blood, but by My Father in heaven.

Matthew 16:18.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 16:18.text: And I tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build My church, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.

Matthew 16:19.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 16:19.text: I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven. Whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.”

Matthew 16:22.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 16:22.text: Peter took Him aside and began to rebuke Him. “Far be it from You, Lord!” he said. “This shall never happen to You!”

Matthew 16:23.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 16:23.text: But Jesus turned and said to Peter, “Get behind Me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to Me. For you do not have in mind the things of God, but the things of men.”

Matthew 16:24.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 16:24.text: Then Jesus told His disciples, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross and follow Me.

Matthew 16:25.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 16:25.text: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake will find it.

Matthew 16:26.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 16:26.text: What will it profit a man if he gains the whole world, yet forfeits his soul? Or what can a man give in exchange for his soul?

Matthew 16:27.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 16:27.text: For the Son of Man will come in His Father’s glory with His angels, and then He will repay each one according to what he has done.

Matthew 16:28.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 16:28.text: Truly I tell you, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the Son of Man coming in His kingdom.”

Matthew 17:4.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 17:4.text: Peter said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If You wish, I will put up three shelters—one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”

Matthew 17:7.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 17:7.text: Then Jesus came over and touched them. “Get up,” He said. “Do not be afraid.”

Matthew 17:9.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 17:9.text: As they were coming down the mountain, Jesus commanded them, “Do not tell anyone about this vision until the Son of Man has been raised from the dead.”

Matthew 17:11.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 17:11.text: Jesus replied, “Elijah does indeed come, and he will restore all things.

Matthew 17:12.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 17:12.text: But I tell you that Elijah has already come, and they did not recognize him, but have done to him whatever they wished. In the same way, the Son of Man will suffer at their hands.”

Matthew 17:15.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 17:15.text: “Lord, have mercy on my son,” he said. “He has seizures and is suffering terribly. He often falls into the fire or into the water.

Matthew 17:16.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 17:16.text: I brought him to Your disciples, but they could not heal him.”

Matthew 17:17.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 17:17.text: “O unbelieving and perverse generation!” Jesus replied. “How long must I remain with you? How long must I put up with you? Bring the boy here to Me.”

Matthew 17:19.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 17:19.text: Afterward the disciples came to Jesus privately and asked, “Why couldn’t we drive it out?”

Matthew 17:20.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 17:20.text: “Because you have so little faith,” He answered. “For truly I tell you, if you have faith the size of a mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move. Nothing will be impossible for you.”

Matthew 17:22.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 17:22.text: When they gathered together in Galilee, Jesus told them, “The Son of Man is about to be delivered into the hands of men.

Matthew 17:23.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 17:23.text: They will kill Him, and on the third day He will be raised to life.” And the disciples were deeply grieved.

Matthew 17:25.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 17:25.text: “Yes,” he answered. When Peter entered the house, Jesus preempted him. “What do you think, Simon?” He asked. “From whom do the kings of the earth collect customs and taxes: from their own sons, or from others?”

Matthew 17:26.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 17:26.text: “From others,” Peter answered. “Then the sons are exempt,” Jesus said to him.

Matthew 17:27.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 17:27.text: “But so that we may not offend them, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take the first fish you catch. When you open its mouth, you will find a four-drachma coin. Take it and give it to them for My tax and yours.”

Matthew 18:1.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:1.text: At that time the disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Who then is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?”

Matthew 18:3.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:3.text: “Truly I tell you,” He said, “unless you change and become like little children, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.

Matthew 18:4.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:4.text: Therefore, whoever humbles himself like this little child is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

Matthew 18:5.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:5.text: And whoever welcomes a little child like this in My name welcomes Me.

Matthew 18:6.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:6.text: But if anyone causes one of these little ones who believe in Me to stumble, it would be better for him to have a large millstone hung around his neck and to be drowned in the depths of the sea.

Matthew 18:7.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:7.text: Woe to the world for the causes of sin. These stumbling blocks must come, but woe to the man through whom they come!

Matthew 18:8.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:8.text: If your hand or your foot causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life crippled or lame than to have two hands and two feet and be thrown into the eternal fire.

Matthew 18:9.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:9.text: And if your eye causes you to sin, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into the fire of hell.

Matthew 18:10.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:10.text: See that you do not look down on any of these little ones. For I tell you that their angels in heaven always see the face of My Father in heaven.

Matthew 18:12.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:12.text: What do you think? If a man has a hundred sheep and one of them goes astray, will he not leave the ninety-nine on the hills and go out to search for the one that is lost?

Matthew 18:13.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:13.text: And if he finds it, truly I tell you, he rejoices more over that one sheep than over the ninety-nine that did not go astray.

Matthew 18:14.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:14.text: In the same way, your Father in heaven is not willing that any of these little ones should perish.

Matthew 18:15.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:15.text: If your brother sins against you, go and confront him privately. If he listens to you, you have won your brother over.

Matthew 18:16.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:16.text: But if he will not listen, take one or two others along, so that ‘every matter may be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.’

Matthew 18:17.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:17.text: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the church. And if he refuses to listen even to the church, regard him as you would a pagan or a tax collector.

Matthew 18:18.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:18.text: Truly I tell you, whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.

Matthew 18:19.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:19.text: Again, I tell you truly that if two of you on the earth agree about anything you ask for, it will be done for you by My Father in heaven.

Matthew 18:20.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:20.text: For where two or three gather together in My name, there am I with them.”

Matthew 18:21.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:21.text: Then Peter came to Jesus and asked, “Lord, how many times shall I forgive my brother who sins against me? Up to seven times?”

Matthew 18:22.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:22.text: Jesus answered, “I tell you, not just seven times, but seventy-seven times!

Matthew 18:23.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:23.text: Because of this, the kingdom of heaven is like a king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.

Matthew 18:24.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:24.text: As he began the settlements, a debtor owing ten thousand talents was brought to him.

Matthew 18:25.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:25.text: Since the man was unable to pay, the master ordered that he be sold to pay his debt, along with his wife and children and everything he owned.

Matthew 18:26.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:26.text: Then the servant fell on his knees before him. ‘Have patience with me,’ he begged, ‘and I will pay back everything.’

Matthew 18:27.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:27.text: His master had compassion on him, forgave his debt, and released him.

Matthew 18:28.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:28.text: But when that servant went out, he found one of his fellow servants who owed him a hundred denarii. He grabbed him and began to choke him, saying, ‘Pay back what you owe me!’

Matthew 18:29.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:29.text: So his fellow servant fell down and begged him, ‘Have patience with me, and I will pay you back.’

Matthew 18:30.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:30.text: But he refused. Instead, he went and had the man thrown into prison until he could pay his debt.

Matthew 18:31.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:31.text: When his fellow servants saw what had happened, they were greatly distressed, and they went and recounted all of this to their master.

Matthew 18:32.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:32.text: Then the master summoned him and said, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave all your debt because you begged me.

Matthew 18:33.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:33.text: Shouldn’t you have had mercy on your fellow servant, just as I had on you?’

Matthew 18:34.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:34.text: In anger his master turned him over to the jailers to be tortured, until he should repay all that he owed.

Matthew 18:35.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 18:35.text: That is how My heavenly Father will treat each of you unless you forgive your brother from your heart.”

Matthew 19:3.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 19:3.text: Then some Pharisees came and tested Him by asking, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”

Matthew 19:4.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 19:4.text: Jesus answered, “Have you not read that from the beginning the Creator ‘made them male and female,’

Matthew 19:5.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 19:5.text: and said, ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh’?

Matthew 19:6.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 19:6.text: So they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore what God has joined together, let man not separate.”

Matthew 19:8.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 19:8.text: Jesus replied, “Moses permitted you to divorce your wives because of your hardness of heart. But it was not this way from the beginning.

Matthew 19:9.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 19:9.text: Now I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another woman commits adultery.”

Matthew 19:14.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 19:14.text: But Jesus said, “Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them! For the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these.”

Matthew 19:16.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 19:16.text: Just then a man came up to Jesus and inquired, “Teacher, what good thing must I do to obtain eternal life?”

Matthew 19:17.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 19:17.text: “Why do you ask Me about what is good?” Jesus replied. “There is only One who is good. If you want to enter life, keep the commandments.”

Matthew 19:18.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 19:18.text: “Which ones?” the man asked. Jesus answered, “‘Do not murder, do not commit adultery, do not steal, do not bear false witness,

Matthew 19:19.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 19:19.text: honor your father and mother, and love your neighbor as yourself.’”

Matthew 19:21.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 19:21.text: Jesus told him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell your possessions and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow Me.”

Matthew 19:23.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 19:23.text: Then Jesus said to His disciples, “Truly I tell you, it is hard for a rich man to enter the kingdom of heaven.

Matthew 19:24.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 19:24.text: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.”

Matthew 19:26.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 19:26.text: Jesus looked at them and said, “With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”

Matthew 19:28.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 19:28.text: Jesus said to them, “Truly I tell you, in the renewal of all things, when the Son of Man sits on His glorious throne, you who have followed Me will also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

Matthew 19:29.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 19:29.text: And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or fields for the sake of My name will receive a hundredfold and will inherit eternal life.

Matthew 19:30.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 19:30.text: But many who are first will be last, and the last will be first.

Matthew 20:1.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 20:1.text: “For the kingdom of heaven is like a landowner who went out early in the morning to hire workers for his vineyard.

Matthew 20:2.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 20:2.text: He agreed to pay them a denarius for the day and sent them into his vineyard.

Matthew 20:3.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 20:3.text: About the third hour he went out and saw others standing in the marketplace doing nothing.

Matthew 20:4.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 20:4.text: ‘You also go into my vineyard,’ he said, ‘and I will pay you whatever is right.’

Matthew 20:5.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 20:5.text: So they went. He went out again about the sixth hour and the ninth hour and did the same thing.

Matthew 20:6.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 20:6.text: About the eleventh hour he went out and found still others standing around. ‘Why have you been standing here all day long doing nothing?’ he asked.

Matthew 20:7.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 20:7.text: ‘Because no one has hired us,’ they answered. So he told them, ‘You also go into my vineyard.’

Matthew 20:8.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 20:8.text: When evening came, the owner of the vineyard said to his foreman, ‘Call the workers and pay them their wages, starting with the last ones hired and moving on to the first.’

Matthew 20:9.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 20:9.text: The workers who were hired about the eleventh hour came and each received a denarius.

Matthew 20:10.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 20:10.text: So when the original workers came, they assumed they would receive more. But each of them also received a denarius.

Matthew 20:11.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 20:11.text: On receiving their pay, they began to grumble against the landowner.

Matthew 20:12.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 20:12.text: ‘These men who were hired last worked only one hour,’ they said, ‘and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden and the scorching heat of the day.’

Matthew 20:13.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 20:13.text: But he answered one of them, ‘Friend, I am not being unfair to you. Did you not agree with me on one denarius?

Matthew 20:14.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 20:14.text: Take your pay and go. I want to give this last man the same as I gave you.

Matthew 20:15.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 20:15.text: Do I not have the right to do as I please with what is mine? Or are you envious because I am generous?’

Matthew 20:16.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 20:16.text: So the last will be first, and the first will be last.”

Matthew 20:17.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 20:17.text: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, He took the twelve disciples aside and said,

Matthew 20:18.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 20:18.text: “Look, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered over to the chief priests and scribes. They will condemn Him to death

Matthew 20:19.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 20:19.text: and will deliver Him over to the Gentiles to be mocked and flogged and crucified. And on the third day He will be raised to life.”

Matthew 20:20.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 20:20.text: Then the mother of Zebedee’s sons came to Jesus with her sons and knelt down to make a request of Him.

Matthew 20:21.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 20:21.text: “What do you want?” He inquired. She answered, “Declare that in Your kingdom one of these two sons of mine may sit at Your right hand, and the other at Your left.”

Matthew 20:22.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 20:22.text: “You do not know what you are asking,” Jesus replied. “Can you drink the cup I am going to drink?” “We can,” the brothers answered.

Matthew 20:23.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 20:23.text: “You will indeed drink My cup,” Jesus said. “But to sit at My right or left is not Mine to grant. These seats belong to those for whom My Father has prepared them.”

Matthew 20:24.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 20:24.text: When the ten heard about this, they were indignant with the two brothers.

Matthew 20:25.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 20:25.text: But Jesus called them aside and said, “You know that the rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their superiors exercise authority over them.

Matthew 20:26.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 20:26.text: It shall not be this way among you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,

Matthew 20:27.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 20:27.text: and whoever wants to be first among you must be your slave—

Matthew 20:28.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 20:28.text: just as the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many.”

Matthew 20:30.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 20:30.text: And there were two blind men sitting beside the road. When they heard that Jesus was passing by, they cried out, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!”

Matthew 20:32.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 20:32.text: Jesus stopped and called them. “What do you want Me to do for you?” He asked.

Matthew 21:2.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 21:2.text: saying to them, “Go into the village ahead of you, and at once you will find a donkey tied there, with her colt beside her. Untie them and bring them to Me.

Matthew 21:3.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 21:3.text: If anyone questions you, tell him that the Lord needs them, and he will send them right away.”

Matthew 21:5.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 21:5.text: “Say to the Daughter of Zion, ‘See, your King comes to you, gentle and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.’”

Matthew 21:9.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 21:9.text: The crowds that went ahead of Him and those that followed were shouting: “Hosanna to the Son of David!” “Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Hosanna in the highest!”

Matthew 21:13.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 21:13.text: And He declared to them, “It is written: ‘My house will be called a house of prayer.’ But you are making it ‘a den of robbers.’”

Matthew 21:15.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 21:15.text: But the chief priests and scribes were indignant when they saw the wonders He performed and the children shouting in the temple courts, “Hosanna to the Son of David!”

Matthew 21:16.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 21:16.text: “Do You hear what these children are saying?” they asked. “Yes,” Jesus answered. “Have you never read: ‘From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise’?”

Matthew 21:19.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 21:19.text: Seeing a fig tree by the road, He went up to it but found nothing on it except leaves. “May you never bear fruit again!” He said. And immediately the tree withered.

Matthew 21:21.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 21:21.text: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus replied, “if you have faith and do not doubt, not only will you do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you say to this mountain, ‘Be lifted up and thrown into the sea,’ it will happen.

Matthew 21:22.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 21:22.text: If you believe, you will receive whatever you ask for in prayer.”

Matthew 21:23.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 21:23.text: When Jesus returned to the temple courts and began to teach, the chief priests and elders of the people came up to Him. “By what authority are You doing these things?” they asked. “And who gave You this authority?”

Matthew 21:24.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 21:24.text: “I will also ask you one question,” Jesus replied, “and if you answer Me, I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.

Matthew 21:25.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 21:25.text: What was the source of John’s baptism? Was it from heaven or from men?” They deliberated among themselves and said, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will ask, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’

Matthew 21:27.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 21:27.text: So they answered, “We do not know.” And Jesus replied, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.

Matthew 21:28.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 21:28.text: But what do you think? There was a man who had two sons. He went to the first one and said, ‘Son, go and work today in the vineyard.’

Matthew 21:29.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 21:29.text: ‘I will not,’ he replied. But later he changed his mind and went.

Matthew 21:30.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 21:30.text: Then the man went to the second son and told him the same thing. ‘I will, sir,’ he said. But he did not go.

Matthew 21:31.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 21:31.text: Which of the two did the will of his father?” “The first,” they answered. Jesus said to them, “Truly I tell you, the tax collectors and prostitutes are entering the kingdom of God before you.

Matthew 21:32.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 21:32.text: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you did not believe him, but the tax collectors and prostitutes did. And even after you saw this, you did not repent and believe him.

Matthew 21:33.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 21:33.text: Listen to another parable: There was a landowner who planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a winepress in it, and built a tower. Then he rented it out to some tenants and went away on a journey.

Matthew 21:34.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 21:34.text: When the harvest time drew near, he sent his servants to the tenants to collect his share of the fruit.

Matthew 21:35.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 21:35.text: But the tenants seized his servants. They beat one, killed another, and stoned a third.

Matthew 21:36.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 21:36.text: Again, he sent other servants, more than the first group. But the tenants did the same to them.

Matthew 21:37.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 21:37.text: Finally, he sent his son to them. ‘They will respect my son,’ he said.

Matthew 21:38.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 21:38.text: But when the tenants saw the son, they said to one another, ‘This is the heir. Come, let us kill him and take his inheritance.’

Matthew 21:39.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 21:39.text: So they seized him and threw him out of the vineyard and killed him.

Matthew 21:40.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 21:40.text: Therefore, when the owner of the vineyard returns, what will he do to those tenants?”

Matthew 21:42.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 21:42.text: Jesus said to them, “Have you never read in the Scriptures: ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone. This is from the Lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes’?

Matthew 21:43.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 21:43.text: Therefore I tell you that the kingdom of God will be taken away from you and given to a people who will produce its fruit.

Matthew 21:44.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 21:44.text: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but he on whom it falls will be crushed.”

Matthew 22:2.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 22:2.text: “The kingdom of heaven is like a king who prepared a wedding banquet for his son.

Matthew 22:3.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 22:3.text: He sent his servants to call those he had invited to the banquet, but they refused to come.

Matthew 22:4.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 22:4.text: Again, he sent other servants and said, ‘Tell those who have been invited that I have prepared my dinner. My oxen and fattened cattle have been killed, and everything is ready. Come to the wedding banquet.’

Matthew 22:5.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 22:5.text: But they paid no attention and went away, one to his field, another to his business.

Matthew 22:6.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 22:6.text: The rest seized his servants, mistreated them, and killed them.

Matthew 22:7.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 22:7.text: The king was enraged, and he sent his troops to destroy those murderers and burn their city.

Matthew 22:8.speaker: Jesus
Matthew 22:8.text: Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding banquet is ready, but those I invited were not worthy.

Matthew 22:9.speaker: Jesus
