Luke 20:14.text: But when the tenants saw the son, they discussed it among themselves and said, ‘This is the heir. Let us kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’

Luke 20:15.speaker: Jesus
Luke 20:15.text: So they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What then will the owner of the vineyard do to them?

Luke 20:16.speaker: Jesus
Luke 20:16.text: He will come and kill those tenants and give the vineyard to others.” And when the people heard this, they said, “May such a thing never happen!”

Luke 20:17.speaker: Jesus
Luke 20:17.text: But Jesus looked directly at them and said, “Then what is the meaning of that which is written: ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone’?

Luke 20:18.speaker: Jesus
Luke 20:18.text: Everyone who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but he on whom it falls will be crushed.”

Luke 20:21.speaker: Jesus
Luke 20:21.text: “Teacher,” they inquired, “we know that You speak and teach correctly. You show no partiality but teach the way of God in accordance with the truth.

Luke 20:22.speaker: Jesus
Luke 20:22.text: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar or not?”

Luke 20:24.speaker: Jesus
Luke 20:24.text: “Show Me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?” “Caesar’s,” they answered.

Luke 20:25.speaker: Jesus
Luke 20:25.text: So Jesus told them, “Give to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.”

Luke 20:34.speaker: Jesus
Luke 20:34.text: Jesus answered, “The sons of this age marry and are given in marriage.

Luke 20:35.speaker: Jesus
Luke 20:35.text: But those who are considered worthy to share in the age to come and in the resurrection from the dead will neither marry nor be given in marriage.

Luke 20:36.speaker: Jesus
Luke 20:36.text: In fact, they can no longer die, because they are like the angels. And since they are sons of the resurrection, they are sons of God.

Luke 20:37.speaker: Jesus
Luke 20:37.text: Even Moses demonstrates that the dead are raised, in the passage about the burning bush. For he calls the Lord ‘the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’

Luke 20:38.speaker: Jesus
Luke 20:38.text: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for to Him all are alive.”

Luke 20:41.speaker: Jesus
Luke 20:41.text: Then Jesus declared, “How can it be said that the Christ is the Son of David?

Luke 20:42.speaker: Jesus
Luke 20:42.text: For David himself says in the book of Psalms: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand

Luke 20:46.speaker: Jesus
Luke 20:46.text: “Beware of the scribes. They like to walk around in long robes, and they love the greetings in the marketplaces, the chief seats in the synagogues, and the places of honor at banquets.

Luke 20:47.speaker: Jesus
Luke 20:47.text: They defraud widows of their houses, and for a show make lengthy prayers. These men will receive greater condemnation.”

Luke 21:3.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:3.text: “Truly I tell you,” He said, “this poor widow has put in more than all the others.

Luke 21:4.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:4.text: For they all contributed out of their surplus, but she out of her poverty has put in all she had to live on.”

Luke 21:6.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:6.text: “As for what you see here, the time will come when not one stone will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”

Luke 21:8.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:8.text: Jesus answered, “See to it that you are not deceived. For many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am He,’ and, ‘The time is near.’ Do not follow them.

Luke 21:9.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:9.text: When you hear of wars and rebellions, do not be alarmed. These things must happen first, but the end is not imminent.”

Luke 21:10.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:10.text: Then He told them, “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.

Luke 21:11.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:11.text: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and pestilences in various places, along with fearful sights and great signs from heaven.

Luke 21:12.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:12.text: But before all this, they will seize you and persecute you. On account of My name they will deliver you to the synagogues and prisons, and they will bring you before kings and governors.

Luke 21:13.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:13.text: This will be your opportunity to serve as witnesses.

Luke 21:14.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:14.text: So make up your mind not to worry beforehand how to defend yourselves.

Luke 21:15.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:15.text: For I will give you speech and wisdom that none of your adversaries will be able to resist or contradict.

Luke 21:16.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:16.text: You will be betrayed even by parents and brothers and relatives and friends, and some of you will be put to death.

Luke 21:17.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:17.text: And you will be hated by everyone because of My name.

Luke 21:18.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:18.text: Yet not even a hair of your head will perish.

Luke 21:19.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:19.text: By your patient endurance you will gain your souls.

Luke 21:20.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:20.text: But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, you will know that her desolation is near.

Luke 21:21.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:21.text: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains, let those in the city get out, and let those in the country stay out of the city.

Luke 21:22.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:22.text: For these are the days of vengeance, to fulfill all that is written.

Luke 21:23.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:23.text: How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers! For there will be great distress upon the land and wrath against this people.

Luke 21:24.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:24.text: They will fall by the edge of the sword and be led captive into all the nations. And Jerusalem will be trodden down by the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.

Luke 21:25.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:25.text: There will be signs in the sun and moon and stars, and on the earth dismay among the nations, bewildered by the roaring of the sea and the surging of the waves.

Luke 21:26.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:26.text: Men will faint from fear and anxiety over what is coming upon the earth, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.

Luke 21:27.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:27.text: At that time they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

Luke 21:28.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:28.text: When these things begin to happen, stand up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is drawing near.”

Luke 21:29.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:29.text: Then Jesus told them a parable: “Look at the fig tree and all the trees.

Luke 21:30.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:30.text: When they sprout leaves, you can see for yourselves and know that summer is near.

Luke 21:31.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:31.text: So also, when you see these things happening, know that the kingdom of God is near.

Luke 21:32.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:32.text: Truly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things have happened.

Luke 21:33.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:33.text: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.

Luke 21:34.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:34.text: But watch yourselves, or your hearts will be weighed down by dissipation, drunkenness, and the worries of life—and that day will spring upon you suddenly like a snare.

Luke 21:35.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:35.text: For it will come upon all who dwell on the face of all the earth.

Luke 21:36.speaker: Jesus
Luke 21:36.text: So keep watch at all times, and pray that you may have the strength to escape all that is about to happen and to stand before the Son of Man.”

Luke 22:8.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:8.text: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and make preparations for us to eat the Passover.”

Luke 22:15.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:15.text: And He said to them, “I have eagerly desired to eat this Passover with you before My suffering.

Luke 22:16.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:16.text: For I tell you that I will not eat it again until it is fulfilled in the kingdom of God.”

Luke 22:17.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:17.text: After taking the cup, He gave thanks and said, “Take this and divide it among yourselves.

Luke 22:18.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:18.text: For I tell you that I will not drink of the fruit of the vine from now on until the kingdom of God comes.”

Luke 22:19.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:19.text: And He took the bread, gave thanks and broke it, and gave it to them, saying, “This is My body, given for you; do this in remembrance of Me.”

Luke 22:20.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:20.text: In the same way, after supper He took the cup, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in My blood, which is poured out for you.

Luke 22:21.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:21.text: Look! The hand of My betrayer is with Mine on the table.

Luke 22:22.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:22.text: Indeed, the Son of Man will go as it has been determined, but woe to that man who betrays Him.”

Luke 22:25.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:25.text: So Jesus declared, “The kings of the Gentiles lord it over them, and those in authority over them call themselves benefactors.

Luke 22:26.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:26.text: But you shall not be like them. Instead, the greatest among you should be like the youngest, and the one who leads like the one who serves.

Luke 22:27.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:27.text: For who is greater, the one who reclines at the table or the one who serves? Is it not the one who reclines? But I am among you as one who serves.

Luke 22:28.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:28.text: You are the ones who have stood by Me in My trials.

Luke 22:29.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:29.text: And I bestow on you a kingdom, just as My Father has bestowed one on Me,

Luke 22:30.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:30.text: so that you may eat and drink at My table in My kingdom and sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

Luke 22:31.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:31.text: Simon, Simon, Satan has asked to sift all of you like wheat.

Luke 22:32.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:32.text: But I have prayed for you, Simon, that your faith will not fail. And when you have turned back, strengthen your brothers.”

Luke 22:34.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:34.text: But Jesus replied, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will not crow today until you have denied three times that you know Me.”

Luke 22:35.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:35.text: Then Jesus asked them, “When I sent you out without purse or bag or sandals, did you lack anything?” “Nothing,” they answered.

Luke 22:36.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:36.text: “Now, however,” He told them, “the one with a purse should take it, and likewise a bag; and the one without a sword should sell his cloak and buy one.

Luke 22:37.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:37.text: For I tell you that this Scripture must be fulfilled in Me: ‘And He was numbered with the transgressors.’ For what is written about Me is reaching its fulfillment.”

Luke 22:38.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:38.text: So they said, “Look, Lord, here are two swords.” “That is enough,” He answered.

Luke 22:40.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:40.text: When He came to the place, He told them, “Pray that you will not enter into temptation.”

Luke 22:42.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:42.text: “Father, if You are willing, take this cup from Me. Yet not My will, but Yours be done.”

Luke 22:46.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:46.text: “Why are you sleeping?” He asked. “Get up and pray so that you will not enter into temptation.”

Luke 22:48.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:48.text: But Jesus asked him, “Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?”

Luke 22:49.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:49.text: Those around Jesus saw what was about to happen and said, “Lord, should we strike with our swords?”

Luke 22:51.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:51.text: But Jesus answered, “No more of this!” And He touched the man’s ear and healed him.

Luke 22:52.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:52.text: Then Jesus said to the chief priests, temple officers, and elders who had come for Him, “Have you come out with swords and clubs as you would against an outlaw?

Luke 22:53.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:53.text: Every day I was with you in the temple courts, and you did not lay a hand on Me. But this hour belongs to you and to the power of darkness.”

Luke 22:64.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:64.text: They blindfolded Him and kept demanding, “Prophesy! Who hit You?”

Luke 22:67.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:67.text: “If You are the Christ, tell us.” Jesus answered, “If I tell you, you will not believe.

Luke 22:68.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:68.text: And if I ask you a question, you will not answer.

Luke 22:69.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:69.text: But from now on the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.”

Luke 22:70.speaker: Jesus
Luke 22:70.text: So they all asked, “Are You then the Son of God?” He replied, “You say that I am.”

Luke 23:2.speaker: Jesus
Luke 23:2.text: And they began to accuse Him, saying, “We found this man subverting our nation, forbidding payment of taxes to Caesar, and proclaiming Himself to be Christ, a King.”

Luke 23:3.speaker: Jesus
Luke 23:3.text: So Pilate asked Him, “Are You the King of the Jews?” “You have said so,” Jesus replied.

Luke 23:21.speaker: Jesus
Luke 23:21.text: but they kept shouting, “Crucify Him! Crucify Him!”

Luke 23:22.speaker: Jesus
Luke 23:22.text: A third time he said to them, “What evil has this man done? I have found in Him no offense worthy of death. So after I punish Him, I will release Him.”

Luke 23:28.speaker: Jesus
Luke 23:28.text: But Jesus turned to them and said, “Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for Me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.

Luke 23:29.speaker: Jesus
Luke 23:29.text: Look, the days are coming when people will say, ‘Blessed are the barren women, the wombs that never bore, and breasts that never nursed!’

Luke 23:30.speaker: Jesus
Luke 23:30.text: At that time ‘they will say to the mountains, “Fall on us!” and to the hills, “Cover us!”’

Luke 23:31.speaker: Jesus
Luke 23:31.text: For if men do these things while the tree is green, what will happen when it is dry?”

Luke 23:34.speaker: Jesus
Luke 23:34.text: Then Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing.” And they divided up His garments by casting lots.

Luke 23:35.speaker: Jesus
Luke 23:35.text: The people stood watching, and the rulers sneered at Him, saying, “He saved others; let Him save Himself if He is the Christ of God, the Chosen One.”

Luke 23:43.speaker: Jesus
Luke 23:43.text: And Jesus said to him, “Truly I tell you, today you will be with Me in Paradise.”

Luke 23:46.speaker: Jesus
Luke 23:46.text: Then Jesus called out in a loud voice, “Father, into Your hands I commit My Spirit.” And when He had said this, He breathed His last.

Luke 23:47.speaker: Jesus
Luke 23:47.text: When the centurion saw what had happened, he gave glory to God, saying, “Surely this was a righteous man.”

Luke 24:17.speaker: Jesus
Luke 24:17.text: He asked them, “What are you discussing so intently as you walk along?” They stood still, with sadness on their faces.

Luke 24:25.speaker: Jesus
Luke 24:25.text: Then Jesus said to them, “O foolish ones, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken!

Luke 24:26.speaker: Jesus
Luke 24:26.text: Was it not necessary for the Christ to suffer these things and then to enter His glory?”

Luke 24:29.speaker: Jesus
Luke 24:29.text: But they pleaded with Him, “Stay with us, for it is nearly evening and the day is almost over.” So He went in to stay with them.

Luke 24:36.speaker: Jesus
Luke 24:36.text: While they were describing these events, Jesus Himself stood among them and said, “Peace be with you.”

Luke 24:38.speaker: Jesus
Luke 24:38.text: “Why are you troubled,” Jesus asked, “and why do doubts arise in your hearts?

Luke 24:39.speaker: Jesus
Luke 24:39.text: Look at My hands and My feet. It is I Myself. Touch Me and see—for a spirit does not have flesh and bones, as you see I have.”

Luke 24:41.speaker: Jesus
Luke 24:41.text: While they were still in disbelief because of their joy and amazement, He asked them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”

Luke 24:44.speaker: Jesus
Luke 24:44.text: Jesus said to them, “These are the words I spoke to you while I was still with you: Everything must be fulfilled that is written about Me in the Law of Moses, the Prophets, and the Psalms.”

Luke 24:46.speaker: Jesus
Luke 24:46.text: And He told them, “This is what is written: The Christ will suffer and rise from the dead on the third day,

Luke 24:47.speaker: Jesus
Luke 24:47.text: and in His name repentance and forgiveness of sins will be proclaimed to all nations, beginning in Jerusalem.

Luke 24:48.speaker: Jesus
Luke 24:48.text: You are witnesses of these things.

Luke 24:49.speaker: Jesus
Luke 24:49.text: And behold, I am sending the promise of My Father upon you. But remain in the city until you have been clothed with power from on high.”

John 1:19.speaker: Jesus
John 1:19.text: And this was John’s testimony when the Jews of Jerusalem sent priests and Levites to ask him, “Who are you?”

John 1:21.speaker: Jesus
John 1:21.text: “Then who are you?” they inquired. “Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the Prophet?” He answered, “No.”

John 1:29.speaker: Jesus
John 1:29.text: The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, “Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

John 1:30.speaker: Jesus
John 1:30.text: This is He of whom I said, ‘A man who comes after me has surpassed me because He was before me.’

John 1:31.speaker: Jesus
John 1:31.text: I myself did not know Him, but the reason I came baptizing with water was that He might be revealed to Israel.”

John 1:36.speaker: Jesus
John 1:36.text: When he saw Jesus walking by, he said, “Look, the Lamb of God!”

John 1:38.speaker: Jesus
John 1:38.text: Jesus turned and saw them following. “What do you want?” He asked. They said to Him, “Rabbi” (which means Teacher), “where are You staying?”

John 1:39.speaker: Jesus
John 1:39.text: “Come and see,” He replied. So they went and saw where He was staying, and spent that day with Him. It was about the tenth hour.

John 1:42.speaker: Jesus
John 1:42.text: Andrew brought him to Jesus, who looked at him and said, “You are Simon son of John. You will be called Cephas” (which is translated as Peter).

John 1:43.speaker: Jesus
John 1:43.text: The next day Jesus decided to set out for Galilee. Finding Philip, He told him, “Follow Me.”

John 1:47.speaker: Jesus
John 1:47.text: When Jesus saw Nathanael approaching, He said of him, “Here is a true Israelite, in whom there is no deceit.”

John 1:48.speaker: Jesus
John 1:48.text: “How do You know me?” Nathanael asked. Jesus replied, “Before Philip called you, I saw you under the fig tree.”

John 1:50.speaker: Jesus
John 1:50.text: Jesus said to him, “Do you believe just because I told you I saw you under the fig tree? You will see greater things than these.”

John 1:51.speaker: Jesus
John 1:51.text: Then He declared, “Truly, truly, I tell you, you will all see heaven open and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”

John 2:3.speaker: Jesus
John 2:3.text: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to Him, “They have no more wine.”

John 2:4.speaker: Jesus
John 2:4.text: “Woman, what is that to you and to Me?” Jesus replied. “My hour has not yet come.”

John 2:7.speaker: Jesus
John 2:7.text: Jesus told the servants, “Fill the jars with water.” So they filled them to the brim.

John 2:8.speaker: Jesus
John 2:8.text: “Now draw some out,” He said, “and take it to the master of the banquet.” They did so,

John 2:16.speaker: Jesus
John 2:16.text: To those selling doves He said, “Get these out of here! How dare you turn My Father’s house into a marketplace!”

John 2:17.speaker: Jesus
John 2:17.text: His disciples remembered that it is written: “Zeal for Your house will consume Me.”

John 2:18.speaker: Jesus
John 2:18.text: On account of this, the Jews demanded, “What sign can You show us to prove Your authority to do these things?”

John 2:19.speaker: Jesus
John 2:19.text: Jesus answered, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up again.”

John 3:2.speaker: Jesus
John 3:2.text: He came to Jesus at night and said, “Rabbi, we know that You are a teacher who has come from God. For no one could perform the signs You are doing if God were not with him.”

John 3:3.speaker: Jesus
John 3:3.text: Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, no one can see the kingdom of God unless he is born again.”

John 3:5.speaker: Jesus
John 3:5.text: Jesus answered, “Truly, truly, I tell you, no one can enter the kingdom of God unless he is born of water and the Spirit.

John 3:6.speaker: Jesus
John 3:6.text: Flesh is born of flesh, but spirit is born of the Spirit.

John 3:7.speaker: Jesus
John 3:7.text: Do not be amazed that I said, ‘You must be born again.’

John 3:8.speaker: Jesus
John 3:8.text: The wind blows where it wishes. You hear its sound, but you do not know where it comes from or where it is going. So it is with everyone born of the Spirit.”

John 3:10.speaker: Jesus
John 3:10.text: “You are Israel’s teacher,” said Jesus, “and you do not understand these things?

John 3:11.speaker: Jesus
John 3:11.text: Truly, truly, I tell you, we speak of what we know, and we testify to what we have seen, and yet you people do not accept our testimony.

John 3:12.speaker: Jesus
John 3:12.text: If I have told you about earthly things and you do not believe, how will you believe if I tell you about heavenly things?

John 3:13.speaker: Jesus
John 3:13.text: No one has ascended into heaven except the One who descended from heaven—the Son of Man.

John 3:14.speaker: Jesus
John 3:14.text: Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up,

John 3:15.speaker: Jesus
John 3:15.text: that everyone who believes in Him may have eternal life.

John 3:16.speaker: Jesus
John 3:16.text: For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.

John 3:17.speaker: Jesus
John 3:17.text: For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through Him.

John 3:18.speaker: Jesus
John 3:18.text: Whoever believes in Him is not condemned, but whoever does not believe has already been condemned, because he has not believed in the name of God’s one and only Son.

John 3:19.speaker: Jesus
John 3:19.text: And this is the verdict: The Light has come into the world, but men loved the darkness rather than the Light because their deeds were evil.

John 3:20.speaker: Jesus
John 3:20.text: Everyone who does evil hates the Light, and does not come into the Light for fear that his deeds will be exposed.

John 3:21.speaker: Jesus
John 3:21.text: But whoever practices the truth comes into the Light, so that it may be seen clearly that what he has done has been accomplished in God.”

John 4:7.speaker: Jesus
John 4:7.text: When a Samaritan woman came to draw water, Jesus said to her, “Give Me a drink.”

John 4:10.speaker: Jesus
John 4:10.text: Jesus answered, “If you knew the gift of God and who is asking you for a drink, you would have asked Him, and He would have given you living water.”

John 4:13.speaker: Jesus
John 4:13.text: Jesus said to her, “Everyone who drinks this water will be thirsty again.

John 4:14.speaker: Jesus
John 4:14.text: But whoever drinks the water I give him will never thirst. Indeed, the water I give him will become in him a fount of water springing up to eternal life.”

John 4:16.speaker: Jesus
John 4:16.text: Jesus told her, “Go, call your husband and come back.”

John 4:17.speaker: Jesus
John 4:17.text: “I have no husband,” the woman replied. Jesus said to her, “You are correct to say that you have no husband.

John 4:18.speaker: Jesus
John 4:18.text: In fact, you have had five husbands, and the man you now have is not your husband. You have spoken truthfully.”

John 4:21.speaker: Jesus
John 4:21.text: “Believe Me, woman,” Jesus replied, “a time is coming when you will worship the Father neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem.

John 4:22.speaker: Jesus
John 4:22.text: You worship what you do not know; we worship what we do know, for salvation is from the Jews.

John 4:23.speaker: Jesus
John 4:23.text: But a time is coming and has now come when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and in truth, for the Father is seeking such as these to worship Him.

John 4:24.speaker: Jesus
John 4:24.text: God is Spirit, and His worshipers must worship Him in spirit and in truth.”

John 4:26.speaker: Jesus
John 4:26.text: Jesus answered, “I who speak to you am He.”

John 4:27.speaker: Jesus
John 4:27.text: Just then His disciples returned and were surprised that He was speaking with a woman. But no one asked Him, “What do You want from her?” or “Why are You talking with her?”

John 4:31.speaker: Jesus
John 4:31.text: Meanwhile the disciples urged Him, “Rabbi, eat something.”

John 4:32.speaker: Jesus
John 4:32.text: But He told them, “I have food to eat that you know nothing about.”

John 4:34.speaker: Jesus
John 4:34.text: Jesus explained, “My food is to do the will of Him who sent Me and to finish His work.

John 4:35.speaker: Jesus
John 4:35.text: Do you not say, ‘There are still four months until the harvest’? I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, for they are ripe for harvest.

John 4:36.speaker: Jesus
John 4:36.text: Already the reaper draws his wages and gathers a crop for eternal life, so that the sower and the reaper may rejoice together.

John 4:37.speaker: Jesus
John 4:37.text: For in this case the saying ‘One sows and another reaps’ is true.

John 4:38.speaker: Jesus
John 4:38.text: I sent you to reap what you have not worked for; others have done the hard work, and now you have taken up their labor.”

John 4:39.speaker: Jesus
John 4:39.text: Many of the Samaritans from that town believed in Jesus because of the woman’s testimony, “He told me everything I ever did.”

John 4:48.speaker: Jesus
John 4:48.text: Jesus said to him, “Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will never believe.”

John 4:50.speaker: Jesus
John 4:50.text: “Go,” said Jesus. “Your son will live.” The man took Jesus at His word and departed.

John 4:53.speaker: Jesus
John 4:53.text: Then the father realized that this was the very hour in which Jesus had told him, “Your son will live.” And he and all his household believed.

John 5:6.speaker: Jesus
John 5:6.text: When Jesus saw him lying there and realized that he had spent a long time in this condition, He asked him, “Do you want to get well?”

John 5:8.speaker: Jesus
John 5:8.text: Then Jesus told him, “Get up, pick up your mat, and walk.”

John 5:14.speaker: Jesus
John 5:14.text: Afterward, Jesus found the man at the temple and said to him, “See, you have been made well. Stop sinning, or something worse may happen to you.”

John 5:17.speaker: Jesus
John 5:17.text: But Jesus answered them, “To this very day My Father is at His work, and I too am working.”

John 5:19.speaker: Jesus
John 5:19.text: So Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing by Himself, unless He sees the Father doing it. For whatever the Father does, the Son also does.

John 5:20.speaker: Jesus
John 5:20.text: The Father loves the Son and shows Him all He does. And to your amazement, He will show Him even greater works than these.

John 5:21.speaker: Jesus
John 5:21.text: For just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, so also the Son gives life to whom He wishes.

John 5:22.speaker: Jesus
John 5:22.text: Furthermore, the Father judges no one, but has assigned all judgment to the Son,

John 5:23.speaker: Jesus
John 5:23.text: so that all may honor the Son just as they honor the Father. Whoever does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent Him.

John 5:24.speaker: Jesus
John 5:24.text: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever hears My word and believes Him who sent Me has eternal life and will not come under judgment. Indeed, he has crossed over from death to life.

John 5:25.speaker: Jesus
John 5:25.text: Truly, truly, I tell you, the hour is coming and has now come when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will live.

John 5:26.speaker: Jesus
John 5:26.text: For as the Father has life in Himself, so also He has granted the Son to have life in Himself.

John 5:27.speaker: Jesus
John 5:27.text: And He has given Him authority to execute judgment, because He is the Son of Man.

John 5:28.speaker: Jesus
John 5:28.text: Do not be amazed at this, for the hour is coming when all who are in their graves will hear His voice

John 5:29.speaker: Jesus
John 5:29.text: and come out—those who have done good to the resurrection of life, and those who have done evil to the resurrection of judgment.

John 5:30.speaker: Jesus
John 5:30.text: I can do nothing by Myself; I judge only as I hear. And My judgment is just, because I do not seek My own will, but the will of Him who sent Me.

John 5:31.speaker: Jesus
John 5:31.text: If I testify about Myself, My testimony is not valid.

John 5:32.speaker: Jesus
John 5:32.text: There is another who testifies about Me, and I know that His testimony about Me is valid.

John 5:33.speaker: Jesus
John 5:33.text: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.

John 5:34.speaker: Jesus
John 5:34.text: Even though I do not accept human testimony, I say these things so that you may be saved.

John 5:35.speaker: Jesus
John 5:35.text: John was a lamp that burned and gave light, and you were willing for a season to bask in his light.

John 5:36.speaker: Jesus
John 5:36.text: But I have testimony more substantial than that of John. For the works that the Father has given Me to accomplish—the very works I am doing—testify about Me that the Father has sent Me.

John 5:37.speaker: Jesus
John 5:37.text: And the Father who sent Me has Himself testified about Me. You have never heard His voice nor seen His form,

John 5:38.speaker: Jesus
John 5:38.text: nor does His word abide in you, because you do not believe the One He sent.

John 5:39.speaker: Jesus
John 5:39.text: You pore over the Scriptures because you presume that by them you possess eternal life. These are the very words that testify about Me,

John 5:40.speaker: Jesus
John 5:40.text: yet you refuse to come to Me to have life.

John 5:41.speaker: Jesus
John 5:41.text: I do not accept glory from men,

John 5:42.speaker: Jesus
John 5:42.text: but I know you, that you do not have the love of God within you.

John 5:43.speaker: Jesus
John 5:43.text: I have come in My Father’s name, and you have not received Me; but if someone else comes in his own name, you will receive him.

John 5:44.speaker: Jesus
John 5:44.text: How can you believe if you accept glory from one another, yet do not seek the glory that comes from the only God?

John 5:45.speaker: Jesus
John 5:45.text: Do not think that I will accuse you before the Father. Your accuser is Moses, in whom you have put your hope.

John 5:46.speaker: Jesus
John 5:46.text: If you had believed Moses, you would believe Me, because he wrote about Me.

John 5:47.speaker: Jesus
John 5:47.text: But since you do not believe what he wrote, how will you believe what I say?”

John 6:5.speaker: Jesus
John 6:5.text: When Jesus looked up and saw a large crowd coming toward Him, He said to Philip, “Where can we buy bread for these people to eat?”

John 6:10.speaker: Jesus
John 6:10.text: “Have the people sit down,” Jesus said. Now there was plenty of grass in that place, so the men sat down, about five thousand of them.

John 6:12.speaker: Jesus
John 6:12.text: And when everyone was full, He said to His disciples, “Gather the pieces that are left over, so that nothing will be wasted.”

John 6:14.speaker: Jesus
John 6:14.text: When the people saw the sign that Jesus had performed, they began to say, “Truly this is the Prophet who is to come into the world.”

John 6:20.speaker: Jesus
John 6:20.text: But Jesus spoke up: “It is I; do not be afraid.”

John 6:26.speaker: Jesus
John 6:26.text: Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, it is not because you saw these signs that you are looking for Me, but because you ate the loaves and had your fill.

John 6:27.speaker: Jesus
John 6:27.text: Do not work for food that perishes, but for food that endures to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you. For on Him God the Father has placed His seal of approval.”

John 6:28.speaker: Jesus
John 6:28.text: Then they inquired, “What must we do to perform the works of God?”

John 6:29.speaker: Jesus
John 6:29.text: Jesus replied, “The work of God is this: to believe in the One He has sent.”

John 6:32.speaker: Jesus
John 6:32.text: Jesus said to them, “Truly, truly, I tell you, it was not Moses who gave you the bread from heaven, but it is My Father who gives you the true bread from heaven.

John 6:33.speaker: Jesus
John 6:33.text: For the bread of God is He who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world.”

John 6:35.speaker: Jesus
John 6:35.text: Jesus answered, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to Me will never hunger, and whoever believes in Me will never thirst.

John 6:36.speaker: Jesus
John 6:36.text: But as I stated, you have seen Me and still you do not believe.

John 6:37.speaker: Jesus
John 6:37.text: Everyone the Father gives Me will come to Me, and the one who comes to Me I will never drive away.

John 6:38.speaker: Jesus
John 6:38.text: For I have come down from heaven, not to do My own will, but to do the will of Him who sent Me.

John 6:39.speaker: Jesus
John 6:39.text: And this is the will of Him who sent Me, that I shall lose none of those He has given Me, but raise them up at the last day.

John 6:40.speaker: Jesus
John 6:40.text: For it is My Father’s will that everyone who looks to the Son and believes in Him shall have eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.”

John 6:41.speaker: Jesus
John 6:41.text: At this, the Jews began to grumble about Jesus because He had said, “I am the bread that came down from heaven.”

John 6:42.speaker: Jesus
John 6:42.text: They were asking, “Is this not Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then can He say, ‘I have come down from heaven’?”

John 6:44.speaker: Jesus
John 6:44.text: “No one can come to Me unless the Father who sent Me draws him, and I will raise him up at the last day.

John 6:45.speaker: Jesus
John 6:45.text: It is written in the Prophets: ‘And they will all be taught by God.’ Everyone who has heard the Father and learned from Him comes to Me—

John 6:46.speaker: Jesus
John 6:46.text: not that anyone has seen the Father except the One who is from God; only He has seen the Father.

John 6:47.speaker: Jesus
John 6:47.text: Truly, truly, I tell you, he who believes has eternal life.

John 6:48.speaker: Jesus
John 6:48.text: I am the bread of life.

John 6:49.speaker: Jesus
John 6:49.text: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, yet they died.

John 6:50.speaker: Jesus
John 6:50.text: This is the bread that comes down from heaven, so that anyone may eat of it and not die.

John 6:51.speaker: Jesus
John 6:51.text: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. And this bread, which I will give for the life of the world, is My flesh.”

John 6:53.speaker: Jesus
John 6:53.text: So Jesus said to them, “Truly, truly, I tell you, unless you eat the flesh and drink the blood of the Son of Man, you have no life in you.

John 6:54.speaker: Jesus
John 6:54.text: Whoever eats My flesh and drinks My blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.

John 6:55.speaker: Jesus
John 6:55.text: For My flesh is real food, and My blood is real drink.

John 6:56.speaker: Jesus
John 6:56.text: Whoever eats My flesh and drinks My blood remains in Me, and I in him.

John 6:57.speaker: Jesus
John 6:57.text: Just as the living Father sent Me and I live because of the Father, so also the one who feeds on Me will live because of Me.

John 6:58.speaker: Jesus
John 6:58.text: This is the bread that came down from heaven. Unlike your fathers, who ate the manna and died, the one who eats this bread will live forever.”

John 6:61.speaker: Jesus
John 6:61.text: Aware that His disciples were grumbling about this teaching, Jesus asked them, “Does this offend you?

John 6:62.speaker: Jesus
John 6:62.text: Then what will happen if you see the Son of Man ascend to where He was before?

John 6:63.speaker: Jesus
John 6:63.text: The Spirit gives life; the flesh profits nothing. The words I have spoken to you are spirit and they are life.

John 6:64.speaker: Jesus
John 6:64.text: However, there are some of you who do not believe.” (For Jesus had known from the beginning which of them did not believe and who would betray Him.)

John 6:65.speaker: Jesus
John 6:65.text: Then Jesus said, “This is why I told you that no one can come to Me unless the Father has granted it to him.”

John 6:67.speaker: Jesus
John 6:67.text: So Jesus asked the Twelve, “Do you want to leave too?”

John 6:70.speaker: Jesus
John 6:70.text: Jesus answered them, “Have I not chosen you, the Twelve? Yet one of you is a devil!”

John 7:3.speaker: Jesus
John 7:3.text: So Jesus’ brothers said to Him, “Leave here and go to Judea, so that Your disciples there may see the works You are doing.

John 7:4.speaker: Jesus
John 7:4.text: For no one who wants to be known publicly acts in secret. Since You are doing these things, show Yourself to the world.”

John 7:6.speaker: Jesus
John 7:6.text: Therefore Jesus told them, “Although your time is always at hand, My time has not yet come.

John 7:7.speaker: Jesus
John 7:7.text: The world cannot hate you, but it hates Me, because I testify that its works are evil.

John 7:8.speaker: Jesus
John 7:8.text: Go up to the feast on your own. I am not going up to this feast, because My time has not yet come.”

John 7:11.speaker: Jesus
John 7:11.text: So the Jews were looking for Him at the feast and asking, “Where is He?”

John 7:16.speaker: Jesus
John 7:16.text: “My teaching is not My own,” Jesus replied. “It comes from Him who sent Me.

John 7:17.speaker: Jesus
John 7:17.text: If anyone desires to do His will, he will know whether My teaching is from God or whether I speak on My own.

John 7:18.speaker: Jesus
John 7:18.text: He who speaks on his own authority seeks his own glory, but He who seeks the glory of the One who sent Him is a man of truth; in Him there is no falsehood.

John 7:19.speaker: Jesus
John 7:19.text: Has not Moses given you the law? Yet not one of you keeps it. Why are you trying to kill Me?”

John 7:21.speaker: Jesus
John 7:21.text: Jesus answered them, “I did one miracle, and you are all amazed.

John 7:22.speaker: Jesus
John 7:22.text: But because Moses gave you circumcision, you circumcise a boy on the Sabbath (not that it is from Moses, but from the patriarchs.)

John 7:23.speaker: Jesus
John 7:23.text: If a boy can be circumcised on the Sabbath so that the law of Moses will not be broken, why are you angry with Me for making the whole man well on the Sabbath?

John 7:24.speaker: Jesus
John 7:24.text: Stop judging by outward appearances, and start judging justly.”

John 7:28.speaker: Jesus
John 7:28.text: Then Jesus, still teaching in the temple courts, cried out, “You know Me, and you know where I am from. I have not come of My own accord, but He who sent Me is true. You do not know Him,

John 7:29.speaker: Jesus
John 7:29.text: but I know Him, because I am from Him and He sent Me.”

John 7:33.speaker: Jesus
John 7:33.text: So Jesus said, “I am with you only a little while longer, and then I am going to the One who sent Me.

John 7:34.speaker: Jesus
John 7:34.text: You will look for Me, but you will not find Me; and where I am, you cannot come.”

John 7:37.speaker: Jesus
John 7:37.text: On the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood up and called out in a loud voice, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to Me and drink.

John 7:38.speaker: Jesus
John 7:38.text: Whoever believes in Me, as the Scripture has said: ‘Streams of living water will flow from within him.’”

John 8:7.speaker: Jesus
John 8:7.text: When they continued to question Him, He straightened up and said to them, “Let him who is without sin among you be the first to cast a stone at her.”

John 8:10.speaker: Jesus
John 8:10.text: Then Jesus straightened up and asked her, “Woman, where are your accusers? Has no one condemned you?”

John 8:11.speaker: Jesus
John 8:11.text: “No one, Lord,” she answered. “Then neither do I condemn you,” Jesus declared. “Now go and sin no more.”

John 8:12.speaker: Jesus
John 8:12.text: Once again, Jesus spoke to the people and said, “I am the light of the world. Whoever follows Me will never walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”

John 8:14.speaker: Jesus
John 8:14.text: Jesus replied, “Even if I testify about Myself, My testimony is valid, because I know where I came from and where I am going. But you do not know where I came from or where I am going.

John 8:15.speaker: Jesus
John 8:15.text: You judge according to the flesh; I judge no one.

John 8:16.speaker: Jesus
John 8:16.text: But even if I do judge, My judgment is true, because I am not alone; I am with the Father who sent Me.

John 8:17.speaker: Jesus
John 8:17.text: Even in your own Law it is written that the testimony of two men is valid.

John 8:18.speaker: Jesus
John 8:18.text: I am One who testifies about Myself, and the Father, who sent Me, also testifies about Me.”

John 8:19.speaker: Jesus
John 8:19.text: “Where is Your Father?” they asked Him. “You do not know Me or My Father,” Jesus answered. “If you knew Me, you would know My Father as well.”

John 8:21.speaker: Jesus
John 8:21.text: Again He said to them, “I am going away, and you will look for Me, but you will die in your sin. Where I am going, you cannot come.”

John 8:22.speaker: Jesus
John 8:22.text: So the Jews began to ask, “Will He kill Himself, since He says, ‘Where I am going, you cannot come’?”

John 8:23.speaker: Jesus
John 8:23.text: Then He told them, “You are from below; I am from above. You are of this world; I am not of this world.

John 8:24.speaker: Jesus
John 8:24.text: That is why I told you that you would die in your sins. For unless you believe that I am He, you will die in your sins.”

John 8:25.speaker: Jesus
John 8:25.text: “Who are You?” they asked. “Just what I have been telling you from the beginning,” Jesus replied.

John 8:26.speaker: Jesus
John 8:26.text: “I have much to say about you and much to judge. But the One who sent Me is truthful, and what I have heard from Him, I tell the world.”

John 8:28.speaker: Jesus
John 8:28.text: So Jesus said, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am He, and that I do nothing on My own, but speak exactly what the Father has taught Me.

John 8:29.speaker: Jesus
John 8:29.text: He who sent Me is with Me. He has not left Me alone, because I always do what pleases Him.”

John 8:31.speaker: Jesus
John 8:31.text: So He said to the Jews who had believed Him, “If you continue in My word, you are truly My disciples.

John 8:32.speaker: Jesus
John 8:32.text: Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”

John 8:34.speaker: Jesus
John 8:34.text: Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, everyone who sins is a slave to sin.

John 8:35.speaker: Jesus
John 8:35.text: A slave does not remain in the house forever, but a son remains forever.

John 8:36.speaker: Jesus
John 8:36.text: So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.

John 8:37.speaker: Jesus
John 8:37.text: I know you are Abraham’s descendants, but you are trying to kill Me because My word has no place within you.

John 8:38.speaker: Jesus
John 8:38.text: I speak of what I have seen in the presence of the Father, and you do what you have heard from your father.”

John 8:39.speaker: Jesus
John 8:39.text: “Abraham is our father,” they replied. “If you were children of Abraham,” said Jesus, “you would do the works of Abraham.

John 8:40.speaker: Jesus
John 8:40.text: But now you are trying to kill Me, a man who has told you the truth that I heard from God. Abraham never did such a thing.

John 8:41.speaker: Jesus
John 8:41.text: You are doing the works of your father.” “We are not illegitimate children,” they declared. “Our only Father is God Himself.”

John 8:42.speaker: Jesus
John 8:42.text: Jesus said to them, “If God were your Father, you would love Me, for I have come here from God. I have not come on My own, but He sent Me.

John 8:43.speaker: Jesus
John 8:43.text: Why do you not understand what I am saying? It is because you are unable to accept My message.

John 8:44.speaker: Jesus
John 8:44.text: You belong to your father, the devil, and you want to carry out his desires. He was a murderer from the beginning, refusing to uphold the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he lies, he speaks his native language, because he is a liar and the father of lies.

John 8:45.speaker: Jesus
John 8:45.text: But because I speak the truth, you do not believe Me!

John 8:46.speaker: Jesus
John 8:46.text: Which of you can prove Me guilty of sin? If I speak the truth, why do you not believe Me?

John 8:47.speaker: Jesus
John 8:47.text: Whoever belongs to God hears the words of God. The reason you do not hear is that you do not belong to God.”

John 8:49.speaker: Jesus
John 8:49.text: “I do not have a demon,” Jesus replied, “but I honor My Father, and you dishonor Me.

John 8:50.speaker: Jesus
John 8:50.text: I do not seek My own glory. There is One who seeks it, and He is the Judge.

John 8:51.speaker: Jesus
John 8:51.text: Truly, truly, I tell you, if anyone keeps My word, he will never see death.”

John 8:54.speaker: Jesus
John 8:54.text: Jesus answered, “If I glorify Myself, My glory means nothing. The One who glorifies Me is My Father, of whom you say, ‘He is our God.’

John 8:55.speaker: Jesus
John 8:55.text: You do not know Him, but I know Him. If I said I did not know Him, I would be a liar like you. But I do know Him, and I keep His word.

John 8:56.speaker: Jesus
John 8:56.text: Your father Abraham rejoiced that he would see My day. He saw it and was glad.”

John 8:58.speaker: Jesus
John 8:58.text: “Truly, truly, I tell you,” Jesus declared, “before Abraham was born, I am!”

John 9:3.speaker: Jesus
John 9:3.text: Jesus answered, “Neither this man nor his parents sinned, but this happened so that the works of God would be displayed in him.

John 9:4.speaker: Jesus
John 9:4.text: While it is daytime, we must do the works of Him who sent Me. Night is coming, when no one can work.

John 9:5.speaker: Jesus
John 9:5.text: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”

John 9:7.speaker: Jesus
John 9:7.text: Then He told him, “Go, wash in the Pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So the man went and washed, and came back seeing.

John 9:8.speaker: Jesus
John 9:8.text: At this, his neighbors and those who had formerly seen him begging began to ask, “Isn’t this the man who used to sit and beg?”

John 9:9.speaker: Jesus
John 9:9.text: Some claimed that he was, but others said, “No, he just looks like him.” But the man kept saying, “I am the one.”

John 9:15.speaker: Jesus
John 9:15.text: So the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. The man answered, “He put mud on my eyes, and I washed, and now I can see.”

John 9:35.speaker: Jesus
John 9:35.text: When Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, He found the man and said, “Do you believe in the Son of Man?”

John 9:36.speaker: Jesus
John 9:36.text: “Who is He, Sir?” he replied. “Tell me so that I may believe in Him.”

John 9:37.speaker: Jesus
John 9:37.text: “You have already seen Him,” Jesus answered. “He is the One speaking with you.”

John 9:38.speaker: Jesus
John 9:38.text: “Lord, I believe,” he said. And he worshiped Jesus.

John 9:39.speaker: Jesus
John 9:39.text: Then Jesus declared, “For judgment I have come into this world, so that the blind may see and those who see may become blind.”

John 9:41.speaker: Jesus
John 9:41.text: “If you were blind,” Jesus replied, “you would not be guilty of sin. But since you claim you can see, your guilt remains.”

John 10:1.speaker: Jesus
John 10:1.text: “Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever does not enter the sheepfold by the gate, but climbs in some other way, is a thief and a robber.

John 10:2.speaker: Jesus
John 10:2.text: But the one who enters by the gate is the shepherd of the sheep.

John 10:3.speaker: Jesus
John 10:3.text: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen for his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.

John 10:4.speaker: Jesus
John 10:4.text: When he has brought out all his own, he goes on ahead of them, and his sheep follow him because they know his voice.

John 10:5.speaker: Jesus
John 10:5.text: But they will never follow a stranger; in fact, they will flee from him because they do not recognize his voice.”

John 10:7.speaker: Jesus
John 10:7.text: So He said to them again, “Truly, truly, I tell you, I am the gate for the sheep.

John 10:8.speaker: Jesus
John 10:8.text: All who came before Me were thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not listen to them.

John 10:9.speaker: Jesus
John 10:9.text: I am the gate. If anyone enters through Me, he will be saved. He will come in and go out and find pasture.

John 10:10.speaker: Jesus
John 10:10.text: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy. I have come that they may have life, and have it in all its fullness.

John 10:11.speaker: Jesus
John 10:11.text: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down His life for the sheep.

John 10:12.speaker: Jesus
John 10:12.text: The hired hand is not the shepherd, and the sheep are not his own. When he sees the wolf coming, he abandons the sheep and runs away. Then the wolf pounces on them and scatters the flock.

John 10:13.speaker: Jesus
John 10:13.text: The man runs away because he is a hired servant and is unconcerned for the sheep.

John 10:14.speaker: Jesus
John 10:14.text: I am the good shepherd. I know My sheep and My sheep know Me,

John 10:15.speaker: Jesus
John 10:15.text: just as the Father knows Me and I know the Father. And I lay down My life for the sheep.

John 10:16.speaker: Jesus
John 10:16.text: I have other sheep that are not of this fold. I must bring them in as well, and they will listen to My voice. Then there will be one flock and one shepherd.

John 10:17.speaker: Jesus
John 10:17.text: The reason the Father loves Me is that I lay down My life in order to take it up again.

John 10:18.speaker: Jesus
John 10:18.text: No one takes it from Me, but I lay it down of My own accord. I have authority to lay it down and authority to take it up again. This charge I have received from My Father.”

John 10:24.speaker: Jesus
John 10:24.text: So the Jews gathered around Him and demanded, “How long will You keep us in suspense? If You are the Christ, tell us plainly.”

John 10:25.speaker: Jesus
John 10:25.text: “I already told you,” Jesus replied, “but you did not believe. The works I do in My Father’s name testify on My behalf.

John 10:26.speaker: Jesus
John 10:26.text: But because you are not My sheep, you refuse to believe.

John 10:27.speaker: Jesus
John 10:27.text: My sheep listen to My voice; I know them, and they follow Me.

John 10:28.speaker: Jesus
John 10:28.text: I give them eternal life, and they will never perish. No one can snatch them out of My hand.

John 10:29.speaker: Jesus
John 10:29.text: My Father who has given them to Me is greater than all. No one can snatch them out of My Father’s hand.

John 10:30.speaker: Jesus
John 10:30.text: I and the Father are one.”

John 10:32.speaker: Jesus
John 10:32.text: But Jesus responded, “I have shown you many good works from the Father. For which of these do you stone Me?”

John 10:34.speaker: Jesus
John 10:34.text: Jesus replied, “Is it not written in your Law: ‘I have said you are gods’?

John 10:35.speaker: Jesus
John 10:35.text: If he called them gods to whom the word of God came—and the Scripture cannot be broken—

John 10:36.speaker: Jesus
John 10:36.text: then what about the One whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world? How then can you accuse Me of blasphemy for stating that I am the Son of God?

John 10:37.speaker: Jesus
John 10:37.text: If I am not doing the works of My Father, then do not believe Me.

John 10:38.speaker: Jesus
John 10:38.text: But if I am doing them, even though you do not believe Me, believe the works themselves, so that you may know and understand that the Father is in Me, and I am in the Father.”

John 11:3.speaker: Jesus
John 11:3.text: So the sisters sent word to Jesus, “Lord, the one You love is sick.”

John 11:4.speaker: Jesus
John 11:4.text: When Jesus heard this, He said, “This sickness will not end in death. No, it is for the glory of God, so that the Son of God may be glorified through it.”

John 11:7.speaker: Jesus
John 11:7.text: and then He said to the disciples, “Let us go back to Judea.”

John 11:9.speaker: Jesus
John 11:9.text: Jesus answered, “Are there not twelve hours of daylight? If anyone walks in the daytime, he will not stumble, because he sees by the light of this world.

John 11:10.speaker: Jesus
John 11:10.text: But if anyone walks at night, he will stumble, because he has no light.”

John 11:11.speaker: Jesus
John 11:11.text: After He had said this, He told them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going there to wake him up.”

John 11:14.speaker: Jesus
John 11:14.text: So Jesus told them plainly, “Lazarus is dead,

John 11:15.speaker: Jesus
John 11:15.text: and for your sake I am glad I was not there, so that you may believe. But let us go to him.”

John 11:21.speaker: Jesus
John 11:21.text: Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.

John 11:22.speaker: Jesus
John 11:22.text: But even now I know that God will give You whatever You ask of Him.”

John 11:23.speaker: Jesus
John 11:23.text: “Your brother will rise again,” Jesus told her.

John 11:25.speaker: Jesus
John 11:25.text: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in Me will live, even though he dies.

John 11:26.speaker: Jesus
John 11:26.text: And everyone who lives and believes in Me will never die. Do you believe this?”

John 11:32.speaker: Jesus
John 11:32.text: When Mary came to Jesus and saw Him, she fell at His feet and said, “Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.”

John 11:34.speaker: Jesus
John 11:34.text: “Where have you put him?” He asked. “Come and see, Lord,” they answered.

John 11:39.speaker: Jesus
John 11:39.text: “Take away the stone,” Jesus said. “Lord, by now he stinks,” said Martha, the sister of the dead man. “It has already been four days.”

John 11:40.speaker: Jesus
John 11:40.text: Jesus replied, “Did I not tell you that if you believed, you would see the glory of God?”

John 11:41.speaker: Jesus
John 11:41.text: So they took away the stone. Then Jesus lifted His eyes upward and said, “Father, I thank You that You have heard Me.

John 11:42.speaker: Jesus
John 11:42.text: I knew that You always hear Me, but I say this for the benefit of the people standing here, so they may believe that You sent Me.”

John 11:43.speaker: Jesus
John 11:43.text: After Jesus had said this, He called out in a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”

John 11:44.speaker: Jesus
John 11:44.text: The man who had been dead came out with his hands and feet bound in strips of linen, and his face wrapped in a cloth. “Unwrap him and let him go,” Jesus told them.

John 11:56.speaker: Jesus
John 11:56.text: They kept looking for Jesus and asking one another as they stood in the temple courts, “What do you think? Will He come to the feast at all?”

John 12:7.speaker: Jesus
John 12:7.text: “Leave her alone,” Jesus replied. “She has kept this perfume in preparation for the day of My burial.

John 12:8.speaker: Jesus
John 12:8.text: The poor you will always have with you, but you will not always have Me.”

John 12:13.speaker: Jesus
John 12:13.text: They took palm branches and went out to meet Him, shouting: “Hosanna!” “Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Blessed is the King of Israel!”

John 12:15.speaker: Jesus
John 12:15.text: “Do not be afraid, O Daughter of Zion. See, your King is coming, seated on the colt of a donkey.”

John 12:23.speaker: Jesus
John 12:23.text: But Jesus replied, “The hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.

John 12:24.speaker: Jesus
John 12:24.text: Truly, truly, I tell you, unless a kernel of wheat falls to the ground and dies, it remains only a seed. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.

John 12:25.speaker: Jesus
John 12:25.text: Whoever loves his life will lose it, but whoever hates his life in this world will keep it for eternal life.

John 12:26.speaker: Jesus
John 12:26.text: If anyone serves Me, he must follow Me; and where I am, My servant will be as well. If anyone serves Me, the Father will honor him.

John 12:27.speaker: Jesus
John 12:27.text: Now My soul is troubled, and what shall I say? ‘Father, save Me from this hour’? No, it is for this purpose that I have come to this hour.

John 12:28.speaker: Jesus
John 12:28.text: Father, glorify Your name!” Then a voice came from heaven: “I have glorified it, and I will glorify it again.”

John 12:30.speaker: Jesus
John 12:30.text: In response, Jesus said, “This voice was not for My benefit, but yours.

John 12:31.speaker: Jesus
John 12:31.text: Now judgment is upon this world; now the prince of this world will be cast out.

John 12:32.speaker: Jesus
John 12:32.text: And I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw everyone to Myself.”

John 12:35.speaker: Jesus
John 12:35.text: Then Jesus told them, “For a little while longer, the Light will be among you. Walk while you have the Light, so that darkness will not overtake you. The one who walks in the darkness does not know where he is going.

John 12:36.speaker: Jesus
John 12:36.text: While you have the Light, believe in the Light, so that you may become sons of light.” After Jesus had spoken these things, He went away and was hidden from them.

John 12:38.speaker: Jesus
John 12:38.text: This was to fulfill the word of Isaiah the prophet: “Lord, who has believed our message? And to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”

John 12:44.speaker: Jesus
John 12:44.text: Then Jesus cried out, “Whoever believes in Me does not believe in Me alone, but in the One who sent Me.

John 12:45.speaker: Jesus
John 12:45.text: And whoever sees Me sees the One who sent Me.

John 12:46.speaker: Jesus
John 12:46.text: I have come into the world as a light, so that no one who believes in Me should remain in darkness.

John 12:47.speaker: Jesus
John 12:47.text: As for anyone who hears My words and does not keep them, I do not judge him. For I have not come to judge the world, but to save the world.

John 12:48.speaker: Jesus
John 12:48.text: There is a judge for the one who rejects Me and does not receive My words: The word that I have spoken will judge him on the last day.

John 12:49.speaker: Jesus
John 12:49.text: I have not spoken on My own, but the Father who sent Me has commanded Me what to say and how to say it.

John 12:50.speaker: Jesus
John 12:50.text: And I know that His command leads to eternal life. So I speak exactly what the Father has told Me to say.”

John 13:7.speaker: Jesus
John 13:7.text: Jesus replied, “You do not realize now what I am doing, but later you will understand.”

John 13:8.speaker: Jesus
John 13:8.text: “Never shall You wash my feet!” Peter told Him. Jesus answered, “Unless I wash you, you have no part with Me.”

John 13:10.speaker: Jesus
John 13:10.text: Jesus told him, “Whoever has already bathed needs only to wash his feet, and he will be completely clean. And you are clean, though not all of you.”

John 13:11.speaker: Jesus
John 13:11.text: For He knew who would betray Him. That is why He said, “Not all of you are clean.”

John 13:21.speaker: Jesus
John 13:21.text: After Jesus had said this, He became troubled in spirit and testified, “Truly, truly, I tell you, one of you will betray Me.”

John 13:25.speaker: Jesus
John 13:25.text: Leaning back against Jesus, he asked, “Lord, who is it?”

John 13:26.speaker: Jesus
John 13:26.text: Jesus answered, “It is the one to whom I give this morsel after I have dipped it.” Then He dipped the morsel and gave it to Judas son of Simon Iscariot.

John 13:27.speaker: Jesus
John 13:27.text: And when Judas had taken the morsel, Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to Judas, “What you are about to do, do quickly.”

John 13:31.speaker: Jesus
John 13:31.text: When Judas had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man is glorified, and God is glorified in Him.

John 13:32.speaker: Jesus
John 13:32.text: If God is glorified in Him, God will also glorify the Son in Himself—and will glorify Him at once.

John 13:33.speaker: Jesus
John 13:33.text: Little children, I am with you only a little while longer. You will look for Me, and as I said to the Jews, so now I say to you: ‘Where I am going, you cannot come.’

John 13:34.speaker: Jesus
John 13:34.text: A new commandment I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you also must love one another.

John 13:35.speaker: Jesus
John 13:35.text: By this everyone will know that you are My disciples, if you love one another.”

John 13:36.speaker: Jesus
John 13:36.text: “Lord, where are You going?” Simon Peter asked. Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you cannot follow Me now, but you will follow later.”

John 13:38.speaker: Jesus
John 13:38.text: “Will you lay down your life for Me?” Jesus replied. “Truly, truly, I tell you, before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times.

John 14:1.speaker: Jesus
John 14:1.text: “Do not let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God; believe in Me as well.

John 14:2.speaker: Jesus
John 14:2.text: In My Father’s house are many rooms. If it were not so, would I have told you that I am going there to prepare a place for you?

John 14:3.speaker: Jesus
John 14:3.text: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come back and welcome you into My presence, so that you also may be where I am.

John 14:4.speaker: Jesus
John 14:4.text: You know the way to the place where I am going.”

John 14:5.speaker: Jesus
John 14:5.text: “Lord,” said Thomas, “we do not know where You are going, so how can we know the way?”

John 14:6.speaker: Jesus
John 14:6.text: Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.

John 14:7.speaker: Jesus
John 14:7.text: If you had known Me, you would know My Father as well. From now on you do know Him and have seen Him.”

John 14:9.speaker: Jesus
John 14:9.text: Jesus replied, “Philip, I have been with you all this time, and still you do not know Me? Anyone who has seen Me has seen the Father. How can you say, ‘Show us the Father’?

John 14:10.speaker: Jesus
John 14:10.text: Do you not believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me? The words I say to you, I do not speak on My own. Instead, it is the Father dwelling in Me, performing His works.

John 14:11.speaker: Jesus
John 14:11.text: Believe Me that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me—or at least believe on account of the works themselves.

John 14:12.speaker: Jesus
John 14:12.text: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever believes in Me will also do the works that I am doing. He will do even greater things than these, because I am going to the Father.

John 14:13.speaker: Jesus
John 14:13.text: And I will do whatever you ask in My name, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

John 14:14.speaker: Jesus
John 14:14.text: If you ask Me for anything in My name, I will do it.

John 14:15.speaker: Jesus
John 14:15.text: If you love Me, you will keep My commandments.

John 14:16.speaker: Jesus
John 14:16.text: And I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Advocate to be with you forever—

John 14:17.speaker: Jesus
John 14:17.text: the Spirit of truth. The world cannot receive Him, because it neither sees Him nor knows Him. But you do know Him, for He abides with you and will be in you.

John 14:18.speaker: Jesus
John 14:18.text: I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.

John 14:19.speaker: Jesus
John 14:19.text: In a little while the world will see Me no more, but you will see Me. Because I live, you also will live.

John 14:20.speaker: Jesus
John 14:20.text: On that day you will know that I am in My Father, and you are in Me, and I am in you.

John 14:21.speaker: Jesus
John 14:21.text: Whoever has My commandments and keeps them is the one who loves Me. The one who loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and reveal Myself to him.”

John 14:23.speaker: Jesus
John 14:23.text: Jesus replied, “If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word. My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him.

John 14:24.speaker: Jesus
John 14:24.text: Whoever does not love Me does not keep My words. The word that you hear is not My own, but it is from the Father who sent Me.

John 14:25.speaker: Jesus
John 14:25.text: All this I have spoken to you while I am still with you.

John 14:26.speaker: Jesus
John 14:26.text: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have told you.

John 14:27.speaker: Jesus
John 14:27.text: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.

John 14:28.speaker: Jesus
John 14:28.text: You heard Me say, ‘I am going away, and I am coming back to you.’ If you loved Me, you would rejoice that I am going to the Father, because the Father is greater than I.

John 14:29.speaker: Jesus
John 14:29.text: And now I have told you before it happens, so that when it does happen, you will believe.

John 14:30.speaker: Jesus
John 14:30.text: I will not speak with you much longer, for the prince of this world is coming, and he has no claim on Me.

John 14:31.speaker: Jesus
John 14:31.text: But I do exactly what the Father has commanded Me, so that the world may know that I love the Father. Get up! Let us go on from here.

John 15:1.speaker: Jesus
John 15:1.text: “I am the true vine, and My Father is the keeper of the vineyard.

John 15:2.speaker: Jesus
John 15:2.text: He cuts off every branch in Me that bears no fruit, and every branch that does bear fruit, He prunes to make it even more fruitful.

John 15:3.speaker: Jesus
John 15:3.text: You are already clean because of the word I have spoken to you.

John 15:4.speaker: Jesus
John 15:4.text: Remain in Me, and I will remain in you. Just as no branch can bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, neither can you bear fruit unless you remain in Me.

John 15:5.speaker: Jesus
John 15:5.text: I am the vine and you are the branches. The one who remains in Me, and I in him, will bear much fruit. For apart from Me you can do nothing.

John 15:6.speaker: Jesus
John 15:6.text: If anyone does not remain in Me, he is like a branch that is thrown away and withers. Such branches are gathered up, thrown into the fire, and burned.

John 15:7.speaker: Jesus
John 15:7.text: If you remain in Me and My words remain in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.

John 15:8.speaker: Jesus
John 15:8.text: This is to My Father’s glory, that you bear much fruit, proving yourselves to be My disciples.

John 15:9.speaker: Jesus
John 15:9.text: As the Father has loved Me, so have I loved you. Remain in My love.

John 15:10.speaker: Jesus
John 15:10.text: If you keep My commandments, you will remain in My love, just as I have kept My Father’s commandments and remain in His love.

John 15:11.speaker: Jesus
John 15:11.text: I have told you these things so that My joy may be in you and your joy may be complete.

John 15:12.speaker: Jesus
John 15:12.text: This is My commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you.

John 15:13.speaker: Jesus
John 15:13.text: Greater love has no one than this, that he lay down his life for his friends.

John 15:14.speaker: Jesus
John 15:14.text: You are My friends if you do what I command you.

John 15:15.speaker: Jesus
John 15:15.text: No longer do I call you servants, for a servant does not understand what his master is doing. But I have called you friends, because everything I have learned from My Father I have made known to you.

John 15:16.speaker: Jesus
John 15:16.text: You did not choose Me, but I chose you. And I appointed you to go and bear fruit—fruit that will remain—so that whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.

John 15:17.speaker: Jesus
John 15:17.text: This is My command to you: Love one another.

John 15:18.speaker: Jesus
John 15:18.text: If the world hates you, understand that it hated Me first.

John 15:19.speaker: Jesus
John 15:19.text: If you were of the world, it would love you as its own. Instead, the world hates you, because you are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world.

John 15:20.speaker: Jesus
John 15:20.text: Remember the word that I spoke to you: ‘No servant is greater than his master.’ If they persecuted Me, they will persecute you as well; if they kept My word, they will keep yours as well.

John 15:21.speaker: Jesus
John 15:21.text: But they will treat you like this because of My name, since they do not know the One who sent Me.

John 15:22.speaker: Jesus
John 15:22.text: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. Now, however, they have no excuse for their sin.

John 15:23.speaker: Jesus
John 15:23.text: Whoever hates Me hates My Father as well.

John 15:24.speaker: Jesus
John 15:24.text: If I had not done among them the works that no one else did, they would not be guilty of sin; but now they have seen and hated both Me and My Father.

John 15:25.speaker: Jesus
John 15:25.text: But this is to fulfill what is written in their Law: ‘They hated Me without reason.’

John 15:26.speaker: Jesus
John 15:26.text: When the Advocate comes, whom I will send to you from the Father—the Spirit of truth who proceeds from the Father—He will testify about Me.

John 15:27.speaker: Jesus
John 15:27.text: And you also must testify, because you have been with Me from the beginning.

John 16:1.speaker: Jesus
John 16:1.text: “I have told you these things so that you will not fall away.

John 16:2.speaker: Jesus
John 16:2.text: They will put you out of the synagogues. In fact, a time is coming when anyone who kills you will think he is offering a service to God.

John 16:3.speaker: Jesus
John 16:3.text: They will do these things because they have not known the Father or Me.

John 16:4.speaker: Jesus
John 16:4.text: But I have told you these things so that when their hour comes, you will remember that I told you about them. I did not tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.

John 16:5.speaker: Jesus
John 16:5.text: Now, however, I am going to Him who sent Me; yet none of you asks Me, ‘Where are You going?’

John 16:6.speaker: Jesus
John 16:6.text: Instead, your hearts are filled with sorrow because I have told you these things.

John 16:7.speaker: Jesus
John 16:7.text: But I tell you the truth, it is for your benefit that I am going away. Unless I go away, the Advocate will not come to you; but if I go, I will send Him to you.

John 16:8.speaker: Jesus
John 16:8.text: And when He comes, He will convict the world in regard to sin and righteousness and judgment:

John 16:9.speaker: Jesus
John 16:9.text: in regard to sin, because they do not believe in Me;

John 16:10.speaker: Jesus
John 16:10.text: in regard to righteousness, because I am going to the Father and you will no longer see Me;

John 16:11.speaker: Jesus
John 16:11.text: and in regard to judgment, because the prince of this world has been condemned.

John 16:12.speaker: Jesus
John 16:12.text: I still have much to tell you, but you cannot yet bear to hear it.

John 16:13.speaker: Jesus
John 16:13.text: However, when the Spirit of truth comes, He will guide you into all truth. For He will not speak on His own, but He will speak what He hears, and He will declare to you what is to come.

John 16:14.speaker: Jesus
John 16:14.text: He will glorify Me by taking from what is Mine and disclosing it to you.

John 16:15.speaker: Jesus
John 16:15.text: Everything that belongs to the Father is Mine. That is why I said that the Spirit will take from what is Mine and disclose it to you.

John 16:16.speaker: Jesus
John 16:16.text: In a little while you will see Me no more, and then after a little while you will see Me.”

John 16:17.speaker: Jesus
John 16:17.text: Then some of His disciples asked one another, “Why is He telling us, ‘In a little while you will not see Me, and then after a little while you will see Me’ and ‘Because I am going to the Father’?”

John 16:19.speaker: Jesus
John 16:19.text: Aware that they wanted to question Him, Jesus said to them, “Are you asking one another why I said, ‘In a little while you will not see Me, and then after a little while you will see Me’?

John 16:20.speaker: Jesus
John 16:20.text: Truly, truly, I tell you, you will weep and wail while the world rejoices. You will grieve, but your grief will turn to joy.

John 16:21.speaker: Jesus
John 16:21.text: A woman has pain in childbirth because her time has come; but when she brings forth her child, she forgets her anguish because of her joy that a child has been born into the world.

John 16:22.speaker: Jesus
John 16:22.text: So also you have sorrow now, but I will see you again and your hearts will rejoice, and no one will take away your joy.

John 16:23.speaker: Jesus
John 16:23.text: In that day you will no longer ask Me anything. Truly, truly, I tell you, whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.

John 16:24.speaker: Jesus
John 16:24.text: Until now you have not asked for anything in My name. Ask and you will receive, so that your joy may be complete.

John 16:25.speaker: Jesus
John 16:25.text: I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. An hour is coming when I will no longer speak to you this way, but will tell you plainly about the Father.

John 16:26.speaker: Jesus
John 16:26.text: In that day you will ask in My name. I am not saying that I will ask the Father on your behalf.

John 16:27.speaker: Jesus
John 16:27.text: For the Father Himself loves you, because you have loved Me and have believed that I came from God.

John 16:28.speaker: Jesus
John 16:28.text: I came from the Father and entered the world. In turn, I will leave the world and go to the Father.”

John 16:32.speaker: Jesus
John 16:32.text: “Look, an hour is coming and has already come when you will be scattered, each to his own home, and you will leave Me all alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with Me.

John 16:33.speaker: Jesus
John 16:33.text: I have told you these things so that in Me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation. But take courage; I have overcome the world!”

John 17:1.speaker: Jesus
John 17:1.text: When Jesus had spoken these things, He lifted up His eyes to heaven and said, “Father, the hour has come. Glorify Your Son, that Your Son may glorify You.

John 17:2.speaker: Jesus
John 17:2.text: For You granted Him authority over all people, so that He may give eternal life to all those You have given Him.

John 17:3.speaker: Jesus
John 17:3.text: Now this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom You have sent.

John 17:4.speaker: Jesus
John 17:4.text: I have glorified You on earth by accomplishing the work You gave Me to do.

John 17:5.speaker: Jesus
John 17:5.text: And now, Father, glorify Me in Your presence with the glory I had with You before the world existed.

John 17:6.speaker: Jesus
John 17:6.text: I have revealed Your name to those You have given Me out of the world. They were Yours; You gave them to Me, and they have kept Your word.

John 17:7.speaker: Jesus
John 17:7.text: Now they know that everything You have given Me comes from You.

John 17:8.speaker: Jesus
John 17:8.text: For I have given them the words You gave Me, and they have received them. They knew with certainty that I came from You, and they believed that You sent Me.

John 17:9.speaker: Jesus
John 17:9.text: I ask on their behalf. I do not ask on behalf of the world, but on behalf of those You have given Me; for they are Yours.

John 17:10.speaker: Jesus
John 17:10.text: All I have is Yours, and all You have is Mine; and in them I have been glorified.

John 17:11.speaker: Jesus
John 17:11.text: I will no longer be in the world, but they are in the world, and I am coming to You. Holy Father, protect them by Your name, the name You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one.

John 17:12.speaker: Jesus
John 17:12.text: While I was with them, I protected and preserved them by Your name, the name You gave Me. Not one of them has been lost, except the son of destruction, so that the Scripture would be fulfilled.

John 17:13.speaker: Jesus
John 17:13.text: But now I am coming to You; and I am saying these things while I am in the world, so that they may have My joy fulfilled within them.

John 17:14.speaker: Jesus
John 17:14.text: I have given them Your word and the world has hated them. For they are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.

John 17:15.speaker: Jesus
John 17:15.text: I am not asking that You take them out of the world, but that You keep them from the evil one.

John 17:16.speaker: Jesus
John 17:16.text: They are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.

John 17:17.speaker: Jesus
John 17:17.text: Sanctify them by the truth; Your word is truth.

John 17:18.speaker: Jesus
John 17:18.text: As You sent Me into the world, I have also sent them into the world.

John 17:19.speaker: Jesus
John 17:19.text: For them I sanctify Myself, so that they too may be sanctified by the truth.

John 17:20.speaker: Jesus
John 17:20.text: I am not asking on behalf of them alone, but also on behalf of those who will believe in Me through their message,

John 17:21.speaker: Jesus
John 17:21.text: that all of them may be one, as You, Father, are in Me, and I am in You. May they also be in Us, so that the world may believe that You sent Me.

John 17:22.speaker: Jesus
John 17:22.text: I have given them the glory You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one—

John 17:23.speaker: Jesus
John 17:23.text: I in them and You in Me—that they may be perfectly united, so that the world may know that You sent Me and have loved them just as You have loved Me.

John 17:24.speaker: Jesus
John 17:24.text: Father, I want those You have given Me to be with Me where I am, that they may see the glory You gave Me because You loved Me before the foundation of the world.

John 17:25.speaker: Jesus
John 17:25.text: Righteous Father, although the world has not known You, I know You, and they know that You sent Me.

John 17:26.speaker: Jesus
John 17:26.text: And I have made Your name known to them and will continue to make it known, so that the love You have for Me may be in them, and I in them.”

John 18:5.speaker: Jesus
John 18:5.text: “Jesus of Nazareth,” they answered. Jesus said, “I am He.” And Judas His betrayer was standing there with them.

John 18:6.speaker: Jesus
John 18:6.text: When Jesus said, “I am He,” they drew back and fell to the ground.

John 18:7.speaker: Jesus
John 18:7.text: So He asked them again, “Whom are you seeking?” “Jesus of Nazareth,” they answered.

John 18:8.speaker: Jesus
John 18:8.text: “I told you that I am He,” Jesus replied. “So if you are looking for Me, let these men go.”

John 18:9.speaker: Jesus
