John 18:9.text: This was to fulfill the word He had spoken: “I have not lost one of those You have given Me.”

John 18:11.speaker: Jesus
John 18:11.text: “Put your sword back in its sheath!” Jesus said to Peter. “Shall I not drink the cup the Father has given Me?”

John 18:20.speaker: Jesus
John 18:20.text: “I have spoken openly to the world,” Jesus answered. “I always taught in the synagogues and at the temple, where all the Jews come together. I said nothing in secret.

John 18:21.speaker: Jesus
John 18:21.text: Why are you asking Me? Ask those who heard My message. Surely they know what I said.”

John 18:22.speaker: Jesus
John 18:22.text: When Jesus had said this, one of the officers standing nearby slapped Him in the face and said, “Is this how You answer the high priest?”

John 18:23.speaker: Jesus
John 18:23.text: Jesus replied, “If I said something wrong, testify as to what was wrong. But if I spoke correctly, why did you strike Me?”

John 18:25.speaker: Jesus
John 18:25.text: Simon Peter was still standing and warming himself. So they asked him, “Aren’t you also one of His disciples?” He denied it and said, “I am not.”

John 18:33.speaker: Jesus
John 18:33.text: Pilate went back into the Praetorium, summoned Jesus, and asked Him, “Are You the King of the Jews?”

John 18:34.speaker: Jesus
John 18:34.text: “Are you saying this on your own,” Jesus asked, “or did others tell you about Me?”

John 18:36.speaker: Jesus
John 18:36.text: Jesus answered, “My kingdom is not of this world; if it were, My servants would fight to prevent My arrest by the Jews. But now My kingdom is not of this realm.”

John 18:37.speaker: Jesus
John 18:37.text: “Then You are a king!” Pilate said. “You say that I am a king,” Jesus answered. “For this reason I was born and have come into the world, to testify to the truth. Everyone who belongs to the truth listens to My voice.”

John 18:38.speaker: Jesus
John 18:38.text: “What is truth?” Pilate asked. And having said this, he went out again to the Jews and told them, “I find no basis for a charge against Him.

John 18:39.speaker: Jesus
John 18:39.text: But it is your custom that I release to you one prisoner at the Passover. So then, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”

John 18:40.speaker: Jesus
John 18:40.text: “Not this man,” they shouted, “but Barabbas!” (Now Barabbas was an insurrectionist.)

John 19:3.speaker: Jesus
John 19:3.text: And they went up to Him again and again, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and slapping Him in the face.

John 19:9.speaker: Jesus
John 19:9.text: and he went back into the Praetorium. “Where are You from?” he asked. But Jesus gave no answer.

John 19:11.speaker: Jesus
John 19:11.text: Jesus answered, “You would have no authority over Me if it were not given to you from above. Therefore the one who handed Me over to you is guilty of greater sin.”

John 19:12.speaker: Jesus
John 19:12.text: From then on, Pilate tried to release Him, but the Jews kept shouting, “If you release this man, you are no friend of Caesar. Anyone who declares himself a king is defying Caesar.”

John 19:26.speaker: Jesus
John 19:26.text: When Jesus saw His mother and the disciple whom He loved standing nearby, He said to His mother, “Woman, here is your son.”

John 19:27.speaker: Jesus
John 19:27.text: Then He said to the disciple, “Here is your mother.” So from that hour, this disciple took her into his home.

John 19:28.speaker: Jesus
John 19:28.text: After this, knowing that everything had now been accomplished, and to fulfill the Scripture, Jesus said, “I am thirsty.”

John 19:30.speaker: Jesus
John 19:30.text: When Jesus had received the sour wine, He said, “It is finished.” And bowing His head, He yielded up His spirit.

John 19:36.speaker: Jesus
John 19:36.text: Now these things happened so that the Scripture would be fulfilled: “Not one of His bones will be broken.”

John 20:2.speaker: Jesus
John 20:2.text: So she came running to Simon Peter and the other disciple, the one whom Jesus loved. “They have taken the Lord out of the tomb,” she said, “and we do not know where they have put Him!”

John 20:15.speaker: Jesus
John 20:15.text: “Woman, why are you weeping?” Jesus asked. “Whom are you seeking?” Thinking He was the gardener, she said, “Sir, if you have carried Him off, tell me where you have put Him, and I will get Him.”

John 20:16.speaker: Jesus
John 20:16.text: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to Him in Hebrew, “Rabboni!” (which means “Teacher”).

John 20:17.speaker: Jesus
John 20:17.text: “Do not cling to Me,” Jesus said, “for I have not yet ascended to the Father. But go and tell My brothers, ‘I am ascending to My Father and your Father, to My God and your God.’”

John 20:18.speaker: Jesus
John 20:18.text: Mary Magdalene went and announced to the disciples, “I have seen the Lord!” And she told them what He had said to her.

John 20:19.speaker: Jesus
John 20:19.text: It was the first day of the week, and that very evening, while the disciples were together with the doors locked for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood among them. “Peace be with you!” He said to them.

John 20:21.speaker: Jesus
John 20:21.text: Again Jesus said to them, “Peace be with you. As the Father has sent Me, so also I am sending you.”

John 20:22.speaker: Jesus
John 20:22.text: When He had said this, He breathed on them and said, “Receive the Holy Spirit.

John 20:23.speaker: Jesus
John 20:23.text: If you forgive anyone his sins, they are forgiven; if you withhold forgiveness from anyone, it is withheld.”

John 20:25.speaker: Jesus
John 20:25.text: So the other disciples told him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he replied, “Unless I see the nail marks in His hands, and put my finger where the nails have been, and put my hand into His side, I will never believe.”

John 20:26.speaker: Jesus
John 20:26.text: Eight days later, His disciples were once again inside with the doors locked, and Thomas was with them. Jesus came and stood among them and said, “Peace be with you.”

John 20:27.speaker: Jesus
John 20:27.text: Then Jesus said to Thomas, “Put your finger here and look at My hands. Reach out your hand and put it into My side. Stop doubting and believe.”

John 20:29.speaker: Jesus
John 20:29.text: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen Me, you have believed; blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.”

John 21:5.speaker: Jesus
John 21:5.text: So He called out to them, “Children, do you have any fish?” “No,” they answered.

John 21:6.speaker: Jesus
John 21:6.text: He told them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” So they cast it there, and they were unable to haul it in because of the great number of fish.

John 21:7.speaker: Jesus
John 21:7.text: Then the disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It is the Lord!” As soon as Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he put on his outer garment (for he had removed it) and jumped into the sea.

John 21:10.speaker: Jesus
John 21:10.text: Jesus told them, “Bring some of the fish you have just caught.”

John 21:12.speaker: Jesus
John 21:12.text: “Come, have breakfast,” Jesus said to them. None of the disciples dared to ask Him, “Who are You?” They knew it was the Lord.

John 21:15.speaker: Jesus
John 21:15.text: When they had finished eating, Jesus asked Simon Peter, “Simon son of John, do you love Me more than these?” “Yes, Lord,” he answered, “You know I love You.” Jesus replied, “Feed My lambs.”

John 21:16.speaker: Jesus
John 21:16.text: Jesus asked a second time, “Simon son of John, do you love Me?” “Yes, Lord,” he answered, “You know I love You.” Jesus told him, “Shepherd My sheep.”

John 21:17.speaker: Jesus
John 21:17.text: Jesus asked a third time, “Simon son of John, do you love Me?” Peter was deeply hurt that Jesus had asked him a third time, “Do you love Me?” “Lord, You know all things,” he replied. “You know I love You.” Jesus said to him, “Feed My sheep.

John 21:18.speaker: Jesus
John 21:18.text: Truly, truly, I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted; but when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and someone else will dress you and lead you where you do not want to go.”

John 21:19.speaker: Jesus
John 21:19.text: Jesus said this to indicate the kind of death by which Peter would glorify God. And after He had said this, He told him, “Follow Me.”

John 21:20.speaker: Jesus
John 21:20.text: Peter turned and saw the disciple whom Jesus loved following them. He was the one who had leaned back against Jesus at the supper to ask, “Lord, who is going to betray You?”

John 21:21.speaker: Jesus
John 21:21.text: When Peter saw him, he asked, “Lord, what about him?”

John 21:22.speaker: Jesus
John 21:22.text: Jesus answered, “If I want him to remain until I return, what is that to you? You follow Me!”

John 21:23.speaker: Jesus
John 21:23.text: Because of this, the rumor spread among the brothers that this disciple would not die. However, Jesus did not say that he would not die, but only, “If I want him to remain until I return, what is that to you?”
